en: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.
zh-TW: 過去被視為森林之神而受到畏懼的寶可夢。有著讀取對手想法並搶先一步行動的能力。

en: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.
zh-TW: 有著熱愛戰鬥的性格。當遇到靠近自己領地的對手，會毫不留情地將之打倒。

en: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokémon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.
zh-TW: 用又尖又硬的腳尖施展踢擊，朝對手的身體和心靈留下無法磨滅的創傷。

en: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a UB and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
zh-TW: 被稱為究極異獸，是來自其他世界的生命體。被認為擁有強烈的神經毒。

en: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
zh-TW: 棲息在其他世界的生命體。身體纖細柔軟，但似乎蘊藏著強大的力量。

en: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.
zh-TW: 在如今已滅亡的沙漠之國曾經是人們珍視的對象。和財寶一起來到了伽勒爾地區。

en: A scent pouch within this Pokémon's body allows it to create various scents. A change in its diet will alter the fragrance it produces.
zh-TW: 用體內的香囊製造香氣的寶可夢。如果更換餵給牠的食物，製造出的香氣也會隨之改變。

en: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
zh-TW: 頭腦聰慧，心地善良的寶可夢。會一邊以優美的聲音歌唱，一邊暢游在大海之上。

en: A solid bond of trust between this Pokémon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.
zh-TW: 與夥伴間深厚的牽絆讓蘊藏在自己體內的力量覺醒。可以隨意改變屬性。

en: According to local rumors, Cleffa are often seen in places where shooting stars have fallen.
zh-TW: 根據當地的傳說，皮寶寶經常出沒的地方就是流星隕落之處。

en: After a lost child perished in the forest, their spirit possessed a tree stump, causing the spirit's rebirth as this Pokémon.
zh-TW: 在森林中迷路死去的孩子的魂魄附在樹樁上，轉生成了寶可夢。

en: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.
zh-TW: 在海底飄蕩的海藻吸收了沉船的零件後轉生而成的幽靈寶可夢。

en: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.
zh-TW: 在雪山中遇難的女性的遺恨讓這隻寶可夢誕生。牠最喜歡凍成冰的靈魂。

en: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.
zh-TW: 搭載了ＡＩ功能後，開始說起了只有多邊獸Ⅱ彼此之間才能了解的神秘語言。

en: After burrowing into the sand, it waits patiently for prey to come near. This Pokémon and Sizzlipede share common descent.
zh-TW: 將自己的身體埋在沙子裡，一聲不響地等待獵物。祖先和燒火蚣的祖先是近親。

en: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
zh-TW: 會用堅硬的蔥葉抵擋攻擊，接著用鋒利的莖反擊。牠的蔥既是武器也是食材。

en: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.
zh-TW: 進化後搬到了陸地上生活，且下半身獲得了強化。用尾巴使出的一擊破壞力十分驚人。

en: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.
zh-TW: 吃飽了之後動作會變得極度遲緩，於是就被古月鳥整隻吞了下去。

en: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
zh-TW: 在日復一日的戰鬥中得以進化。進化的結果是那危險的指甲，留長後能當作短劍來用。

en: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.
zh-TW: 每到太陽下山時，牠便會離開居住的洞窟四處飛行，用超音波尋找熟透的果實。

en: After two Binacle find a suitably sized rock, they adhere themselves to it and live together. They cooperate to gather food during high tide.
zh-TW: ２隻龜腳腳會在海邊找一塊大小合適的岩石，附在上面一起生活。漲潮的時候會互相合作尋找食物。

en: All Spiritomb's mischief and misdeeds compelled a traveler to use a mysterious spell to bind Spiritomb to an odd keystone.
zh-TW: 總是作惡多端，不料有一天被使用神奇法術的旅人綁縛到了楔石上。

en: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.
zh-TW: 雖然是個性溫順的寶可夢，但生氣時就會大力揮甩尾巴上的大球來擊打對手。

en: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
zh-TW: 原本沒有棲息在阿羅拉，是在過去小拉達大量繁殖的時候被人們帶過來的。

en: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
zh-TW: 在這個世界是危險的異類，但牠在原本棲息的世界裡似乎是隨處可見的普通生物。

en: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
zh-TW: 雖被稱為守護神，但會去襲擊惹自己不開心的人或寶可夢，是個性情凶悍的神。

en: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
zh-TW: 雖被稱呼為守護神，但有著會將自己視為敵人的對手徹底擊潰的狂暴個性。

en: Although it's carrying its baby in a pouch on its belly, Kangaskhan is swift on its feet. It intimidates its opponents with quick jabs.
zh-TW: 腹部的袋子裡裝著孩子，但是步法非常輕盈。會用高速的刺拳威嚇對手。

en: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.
zh-TW: 個性粗魯又任性，但討厭欺負弱小這種無聊的事，只有在面對強大對手時才會拿出幹勁。

en: Although this Pokémon isn't very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.
zh-TW: 雖然弱小，但牠擁有可以融化一切的黏液來保護自己，因此未被捕食並得以存活至今。

en: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.
zh-TW: 外表醜陋，所以不受歡迎。擁有驚人的生命力，因而成為了研究對象。

en: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
zh-TW: 從敵人散發出的氣場來判斷對方下一步的行動。能輕盈地躲開攻擊並進行反擊。

en: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.
zh-TW: 會像船槳般划動８片翅膀在水中快速游動。是蟲寶可夢祖先的一種。

en: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokémon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
zh-TW: 會用頭部的果蒂擊打飛來啄食自己的藍鴉，並且對牠使出猛烈的踢擊。

en: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
zh-TW: 牠角裡的多龍梅西亞似乎滿心期待著能被以音速發射出去。

en: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.
zh-TW: 雖然身體的裂縫會因白天的活動而變大，但只要一晚就能全部長好。

en: As Psyduck gets stressed out, its headache gets progressively worse. It uses intense psychic energy to overwhelm those around it.
zh-TW: 頭痛會隨著壓力累積而更加劇烈。會用強大的念力壓倒周圍的一切。

en: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.
zh-TW: 隨著牠歷經越多的對戰，鐮刀也就會變得越鋒利。連大樹也能一刀劈成兩半。

en: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
zh-TW: 在漆黑的夜裡奔馳，吸取正在睡覺的生物的生命能量。喜愛孤獨與寂靜。

en: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
zh-TW: 正在殼裡成長著。用精神力量掌握外界的狀況，做好進化的準備。

en: As long as this Pokémon bathes in sunlight, its cotton keeps growing. If too much cotton fluff builds up, Whimsicott tears it off and scatters it.
zh-TW: 每當沐浴陽光，身上的棉花就會膨脹。如果膨脹過了頭，牠就會把棉花扯開到處亂撒。

en: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.
zh-TW: 當牠嗅到獵物的氣味，就會從臀部噴射出海水，發動時速１２０公里的襲擊。

en: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
zh-TW: 一出生就躲進了蘋果中，一邊吃果肉一邊成長。進化方向依蘋果的味道而定。

en: At nightfall, these Pokémon appear on the shores of lakes. They announce their territorial claims by letting out cries that sound like shouting.
zh-TW: 天黑後就會出現在池子邊。會用怒吼般的聲音大叫，來強調那是自己的地盤喔。

en: At times, Magnemite runs out of electricity and ends up on the ground. If you give batteries to a grounded Magnemite, it'll start moving again.
zh-TW: 有時也會因為耗盡了體內的電力而掉落在地面上。給牠電池，牠就會再次動起來喔。

en: Audino's sense of hearing is superb. Not even a pebble rolling along over a mile away will escape Audino's ears.
zh-TW: 擁有極為敏銳的聽覺。連２公里外有小石子滾動的聲音牠都能聽見。

en: Aurorus was restored from a fossil. It's said that when this Pokémon howls, auroras appear in the night sky.
zh-TW: 從化石復原的寶可夢。據說當冰雪巨龍吼叫時，夜空中就會出現極光。

en: Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn't form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.
zh-TW: 不集結成群，而是單獨生活。擁有硬得不得了的頭部，能夠一擊就把堅硬的岩石撞成兩半。

en: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
zh-TW: 一定要小心牠那包覆著靈魂的靈體。如果觸摸到，就會像石頭一樣動彈不得。

en: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
zh-TW: 翅膀還沒有完全長好，所以只能一跳一跳地移動。一直在注視著什麼。

en: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.
zh-TW: 性情粗暴、血氣方剛，因此被鋼鎧鴉奪走了伽勒爾運送員的地位。

en: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
zh-TW: 敲響鱗片、發出吼聲，接著向對手發起挑戰，並用鋒利的爪子撕裂對手。

en: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
zh-TW: 被大舌貝狠狠咬下的衝擊讓牠變得能用兩腳行走。如果大舌貝脫落了，牠似乎就會變回呆呆獸。

en: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
zh-TW: 有時美麗花們會聚在一起，做出像是跳舞的動作。據說這是呼喚太陽的儀式。

en: Blissey lays mysterious eggs that are filled with happiness. It's said that anyone who eats a Blissey egg will start acting kindly to all others.
zh-TW: 會生下飽含幸福的神奇的蛋。據說吃下蛋的人，就能夠對任何人都很溫和相待。

en: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.
zh-TW: 誕生於地底深處。把周圍的泥土都吃光後，就會出現在地上變成蛹。

en: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.
zh-TW: 雙腳變成了翅膀。能夠無聲無息地高速飛行，用獠牙咬住獵物的後頸。

en: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.
zh-TW: 蟲寶可夢是牠主要的食物。會用長長的舌頭去把對方舔麻痺，然後趁機一口吞下。

en: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.
zh-TW: 巨大的鉗子重達體重的３分之１。鉗子一揮，就連岩石都能一擊粉碎。

en: Buneary can attack by rolling up their ears and then striking with the force created by unrolling them. This attack becomes stronger with training.
zh-TW: 會利用把捲成團的耳朵伸直時的威力來使出攻擊招式。越訓練，招式威力就會越大。

en: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.
zh-TW: 會挖掘洞穴，從樹木的根部獲取營養，但幾乎所有的營養都會被背上的蘑菇奪走。

en: By detonating gas that accumulates in its right claw, this Pokémon launches water like a bullet. This is how Clauncher defeats its enemies.
zh-TW: 右臂的鉗子能夠累積氣體，並且利用氣體爆炸噴射出像子彈般的水來打倒敵人。

en: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
zh-TW: 能夠透過打鼓來控制特別的樹樁中的力量，操縱樹根進行戰鬥。

en: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
zh-TW: 能透過高速旋轉自己的腳，以３０公里的時速奔跑。能噴出攝氏１０００度的火焰。

en: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.
zh-TW: 能從人們身上的氣味裡嗅出他們的身心狀態。在醫療領域的實際應用備受矚目。

en: Clawitzer's right arm is a cannon that launches projectiles made of seawater. Shots from a Clawitzer's cannon arm can sink a tanker.
zh-TW: 右臂是能夠發射海水砲彈的大砲。威力之強，甚至能夠擊沉油輪。

en: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.
zh-TW: 會用藤蔓摘花來裝飾自己。不知為何，黏在牠身上的花朵都不會枯萎。

en: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
zh-TW: 無論多麼堅硬的樹果殼都能用引以為傲的大牙咬碎。在伽勒爾是很常見的寶可夢。

en: Concrete mixed by Conkeldurr is much more durable than normal concrete, even when the compositions of the two materials are the same.
zh-TW: 即使成分相同，修建老匠攪拌的混凝土格外地堅硬結實。

en: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
zh-TW: 性情謹慎且狡猾。在偷盜食物逃走的時候會用尾巴擦掉自己的足跡。

en: Despite its small size, it can zap even adult humans. However, if it does so, it also surprises itself.
zh-TW: 身形小巧，卻能夠釋放出足以讓成年人麻痺的電擊，但是連牠自己也會嚇一跳。

en: Dragalge generates dragon energy by sticking the plume on its head out above the ocean's surface and bathing it in sunlight.
zh-TW: 透過讓頭頂類似帽子的部分浮出海面吸收陽光，就能夠製造龍之能量。

en: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.
zh-TW: 棲息在瀑布潭等水流湍急的水邊。會藉由反覆蛻皮不斷地長大。

en: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
zh-TW: 性情凶暴且狡猾。會搶奪其他寶可夢挖好的巢穴，來當作是自己的窩。

en: During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.
zh-TW: 會互相碰撞身體來爭奪地盤。仔細看牠的鋼鐵盔甲，就會發現有傷痕及凹痕。

en: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
zh-TW: 白天為了躲避太陽，會鑽進涼爽的地下。藉由沐浴月光來成長。

en: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
zh-TW: 在火山上生活，吃下的硫磺就是甲殼上炸藥的原料。連糞便也會爆炸，十分危險。

en: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.
zh-TW: 深夜時分，牠身體裡發出的詭異叫聲似乎是死者在另一個世界裡的痛苦哭聲。

en: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.
zh-TW: 很能彈開水的體毛就算是從寒冷的海裡上岸時也能立刻乾掉，一點都不冷。

en: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
zh-TW: 被外殼覆蓋，但能自由自在地跳來跳去。兼具硬度與速度，因此破壞力超群。

en: Even though it is small, it can't be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.
zh-TW: 體型雖小卻不可輕視，因為牠只要發現合適的對手，就會馬上撲上去大打出手。

en: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.
zh-TW: 不可靠的氣體狀身體只要稍微有點風就會被吹走，但牠看起來一點都不在意。

en: Even when nobody seems to be around, Gothita can still be heard making a muted cry. Many believe it's speaking to something only it can see.
zh-TW: 哥德寶寶會在看似無人的地方輕聲地叫。牠好像是在與某種只有牠才看得見的東西說話。

en: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
zh-TW: 性格忠誠。為了保護自己的訓練家，會拼命地朝對手狂吠。

en: Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn't bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.
zh-TW: 會被魚寶可夢啄食，但是即使身體被咬斷也能很快就再生，所以一點都不在意。

en: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.
zh-TW: 會朝著獵物的巢穴中噴射火花，再用銳利的爪子解決掉受驚嚇而跑出來的獵物。

en: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.
zh-TW: 在黑暗中一邊飛行一邊發出能粉碎岩石的超音波痛擊敵人，然後用利齒給予致命的一擊。

en: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokémon's innards showing through the skin.
zh-TW: 比起步行更擅長游泳。腹部的漩渦花紋是透過皮膚可以看到的部分內臟。

en: For protection, it releases a horrible stench from the antenna on its head to drive away enemies.
zh-TW: 會從頭部的觸角釋放出強烈的氣味來趕走敵人，藉此保護自己。

en: For some reason, this Pokémon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
zh-TW: 當從身上的黃色斑紋裡釋放出強大電流時，牠會莫名地露出微笑。

en: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.
zh-TW: 會從臀部放出磁力將敵人迅猛地吸到身邊，再以銳利的爪子刺穿對方。

en: From its rear, it sprays a foul-smelling liquid at opponents. It aims for their faces, and it can hit them from over 16 feet away.
zh-TW: 瞄準對手的臉，從屁股噴出奇臭無比的液體。液體能噴到５公尺外。

en: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.
zh-TW: 會從尖刺的前端發出強力電擊。紅色核心裡填充著非常多的能量。

en: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
zh-TW: 從出生時開始尾巴上就有火焰在燃燒。火焰熄滅時，生命也會結束。

en: Galarians favor the distinctive aroma that drifts from this Pokémon's leaves. There's a popular perfume made using that scent.
zh-TW: 伽勒爾人對牠的葉片散發出的獨特香氣情有獨鍾。用這種香氣加工出的香水非常受歡迎。

en: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.
zh-TW: 棲息在火山區的山中。會以不遜於噴射戰鬥機的速度在天空飛行，盡情地獵取獵物。

en: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.
zh-TW: 要是盯著牠的發光體看，就會馬上陷入催眠狀態，並且受到牠的控制。

en: Gible attacks anything that moves, and it drags whatever it catches into the crevice that is its lair. Despite the big mouth, Gible's stomach is small.
zh-TW: 會不分青紅皂白地襲擊會動的東西，將對方拖進自己睡覺的小洞裡。雖然嘴巴很大，但胃卻算是小的。

en: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
zh-TW: 擁有十分驚人的怪力。遮住臉部的冰面罩比鑽石還要堅硬１００倍。

en: Happiny's willing to lend its precious round stone to those it's friendly with, but if the stone isn't returned, Happiny will cry and throw a tantrum.
zh-TW: 會把寶貝的渾圓石頭借給變得友好的對象。如果不還給牠的話，就會哭著大鬧。

en: Having an eye on each palm allows it to keep watch in all directions. In a pinch, its limbs start to act on their own to ensure the enemy's defeat.
zh-TW: 用手掌上的眼珠來觀察前後左右的狀況。遇上危機時手腳會自己動起來打倒對手。

en: Herdier is a very smart and friendly Pokémon. So much so that there's a theory that Herdier was the first Pokémon to partner with people.
zh-TW: 非常聰明，容易與人親近。甚至有人說，牠是最先成為人類同伴的寶可夢。

en: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.
zh-TW: 藤蔓即使斷了也會繼續無限地生長。藤蔓下的真面目至今仍是個謎。

en: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
zh-TW: 頭腦聰明但是很怕麻煩。為了不讓敵人接近自己的地盤，在各個地方都設下了陷阱。

en: Honedge's soul once belonged to a person who was killed a long time ago by the sword that makes up Honedge's body.
zh-TW: 很久以前因這把劍而喪命之人的靈魂成為了獨劍鞘的靈魂。

en: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
zh-TW: 拉緊頭上又白又長的體毛就會變得氣勢高昂，並且由丹田湧出力量。

en: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
zh-TW: 擅長需要力氣的工作。銅質的身體會因雨水而生鏽，轉變成鮮豔的綠色。

en: If a tree branch shakes when there is no wind, it's a Sudowoodo, not a tree. It hides from the rain.
zh-TW: 如果在沒風的日子看見樹在搖擺，那就是樹才怪。據說在下雨時會躲起來。

en: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
zh-TW: 游動時速度上來後，甚至會從波浪上飛起來，然後就這樣滑翔１００公尺。

en: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
zh-TW: 朝著對手衝過去時，背上的體毛會倒豎起來。對聲音極度敏感。

en: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
zh-TW: 當雷伊布生氣或是吃驚時，牠全身的體毛會像針一樣豎起來刺穿對手。

en: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.
zh-TW: 與牠視線交會是很危險的！不管對手是誰，牠都會用頭錘招呼，是個難搞的傢伙。

en: If it sees any packs of Darumaka going after Snover, it chases them off, swinging its sizable arms like hammers.
zh-TW: 會像揮動鎚子般揮下自己大大的手臂，趕走要襲擊雪笠怪的火紅不倒翁群體。

en: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
zh-TW: 如果危險逼近，就會從嘴裡吐出泡沫包裹全身，讓身體看起來更大。

en: If it spies a strong Pokémon, Rufflet can't resist challenging it to a battle. But if Rufflet loses, it starts bawling.
zh-TW: 每當遇到看似強勁的寶可夢，都會忍不住去挑起戰鬥。如果輸了就會放聲大哭。

en: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
zh-TW: 當訓練家高興的時候，奇魯莉安會充滿能量，開心地轉著圈跳舞。

en: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
zh-TW: 如果電囊空了，牠就會直直地豎起尾巴，收集空氣中的電流。

en: If its face gets even slightly dirty, Smoochum will bathe immediately. But if its body gets dirty, Smoochum doesn't really seem to care.
zh-TW: 只要稍微弄髒了臉，就會馬上去用水沖乾淨。但對於身體的髒污似乎就不太在意。

en: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
zh-TW: 要是身上的毛長得太長就會不能動彈。用毛辮羊的體毛織成的布結實得讓人吃驚。

en: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
zh-TW: 有危險逼近群體時，會與夥伴們團結一致地用超音波的大合唱來攻擊。

en: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
zh-TW: 喜歡沒有人煙的地方。一旦感覺到強烈的情感，就會一溜煙地逃走。

en: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.
zh-TW: 當牠站在電視機旁邊時，畫面上會出現奇怪的景色。據說那是牠的故鄉。

en: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
zh-TW: 雖然單獨１隻弱得甚至敵不過小孩，但會和夥伴合作一起鍛鍊，透過進化而變得更強。

en: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.
zh-TW: 不斷地尋求強大的實力。要是看到了在山上修行的打擊鬼，就靜靜地離開吧。

en: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.
zh-TW: 如果被糾纏不休，就會變得不肯打開心扉。就算和牠變得親近了，也嚴禁與牠有過度的親密接觸。

en: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
zh-TW: 又被稱為森林魔女。如果有人大吵大鬧，可能會被牠用觸手上的爪子撕碎。

en: In its belly, it reserves stinky fluid that it shoots from its tail during battle. As this Pokémon's diet varies, so does the stench of its fluid.
zh-TW: 會在肚子裡囤滿臭液，從尾巴噴出臭液攻擊敵人。臭味會依吃下的東西而不同。

en: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.
zh-TW: 近年在電腦空間大展身手。會四處巡邏查看有沒有可疑的資料。

en: In terms of electrical-energy output, Electivire is one of the best among all Electric Pokémon. It discharges high-voltage currents from its tails.
zh-TW: 發電量在電氣寶可夢中是屬於最頂級的。會從尾巴的前端放出高壓電流。

en: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
zh-TW: 南瓜怪人會在朔月的夜裡去別人家門口敲門。開了門的人會被牠帶往另一個世界。

en: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.
zh-TW: 單獨１隻十分弱小，所以學會了透過群體行動，來對抗敵人的能力。

en: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
zh-TW: 棲息在遙遠地區的山岳地帶。會在斷崖絕壁上來回奔跑鍛鍊下盤，磨練招式。

en: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
zh-TW: 污濁的空氣是牠的美味大餐。據說在昔日的伽勒爾地區曾經存在著更多的瓦斯彈。

en: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.
zh-TW: 在使出致命的絕招之前一定要先擺出華麗的姿勢。有時也會在這一刻遭到反擊。

en: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
zh-TW: 從究極之洞中出現。似乎是由多數的生命堆積起來形成的個體。

en: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
zh-TW: 似乎是從古代人做的泥偶誕生而來的寶可夢。能靠念力飄浮在空中移動。

en: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
zh-TW: 會將頭頂黏在樹枝上懸掛著。也有被大風吹落的時候。

en: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
zh-TW: 會用木棒連續擊打來攻擊。在以飛快的速度擊打的同時，情緒也會變得越來越高漲。

en: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.
zh-TW: 總是在固定的時間鳴叫，因此也有訓練家拿牠來代替鐘錶帶出門。

en: It begins walking on its hind legs after evolution. It can punch holes through boulders with its horn.
zh-TW: 進化後變得只用後腳就能站立。如果被牠的角刺中，就連岩石也會被開出洞來。

en: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.
zh-TW: 一躍而起接近敵人，用有毒的爪子狠抓對方！光是擦傷就能將對手ＫＯ。

en: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
zh-TW: 用腹部發電，並把電力集中在大大的顎部，釋放出能量驚人的光束。

en: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
zh-TW: 會在甲殼中燃燒煤炭產生能量。遇到危機時會噴出黑色的煤煙。

en: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.
zh-TW: 會潛藏在沙子裡，從頭部的突起物發射精神力量，在探查周圍狀況的同時等待獵物。

en: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
zh-TW: 會在地面挖洞築巢。即使遇到地下堅硬的岩石，也會用銳利的爪子擊碎並向前挖進。

en: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
zh-TW: 在地下較淺的地方移動。被牠挖掘過的地面會鼓起來，所以非常容易發現。

en: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.
zh-TW: 變得親近後也會對訓練家撒嬌。但因為力氣很大，爪子又很銳利，訓練家會被弄得全身是傷。

en: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
zh-TW: 只要噘起鳥嘴的前端，就能自在地發出１００種以上的叫聲。

en: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.
zh-TW: 飛行速度不可小覷。無論飛到多遠的地方，都會記得自己的主人和巢。

en: It can load up to three projectiles per arm into the holes in its hands. What launches out of those holes could be either rocks or Roggenrola.
zh-TW: 會在手掌的洞裡塞進岩石和石丸子發射出去，每隻手裡可以裝填３個。

en: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.
zh-TW: 只能在寒冷的土地上生存。即使在零下１００度的環境下也能充滿活力地到處蹦蹦跳跳哦。

en: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
zh-TW: 在滿是岩石的崎嶇路面上也能像獨輪車那樣自在移動。靠燃燒煤炭維持生命。

en: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.
zh-TW: 能夠藉由重組全身的細胞，變得與看到的東西一模一樣，然而一旦放鬆就會變回原形。

en: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
zh-TW: 有時會在土裡生活１０年以上。會從樹木的根部吸取營養。

en: It can use waves called auras to gauge how others are feeling. These same waves can also tell this Pokémon about the state of the environment.
zh-TW: 除了能讀懂對手的感情，也能以「波導」這種形式的波來觀察大自然的樣子。

en: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
zh-TW: 剛出生的時候不擅長奔跑，但隨著和夥伴們不斷地賽跑，會逐漸鍛鍊出強健的腳力。

en: It can't suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.
zh-TW: 雖然吸入空氣的力量稍弱於伽勒爾的雙彈瓦斯，製造出的毒素卻更加強力。

en: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
zh-TW: 無論怎麼吃都會馬上肚子餓。十分珍愛自己用電烘烤過的種子，隨時都帶在身上。

en: It charges its enemies, lances at the ready. An image of one of its duels is captured in a famous painting of Escavalier clashing with Sirfetch'd.
zh-TW: 會舉起長矛突擊敵人。有一幅名畫描繪著牠和蔥遊兵決鬥的場景。

en: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
zh-TW: 大嘴娃能用自己那由鋼角變化而成的巨大顎部將對手一口緊緊咬住。

en: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokémon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.
zh-TW: 遇到敵人便會敲響尾部的鱗片來威嚇對方。只會與不畏懼自己的強者戰鬥。

en: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
zh-TW: 會用銳利的爪子當作鉤子來爬樹。這是為了將樹果擊落，分給在樹下等待的穿山鼠們。

en: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
zh-TW: 每天都忙著採集花蜜。習慣在腿部的細毛上塗滿花蜜，然後帶回巢穴裡。

en: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.
zh-TW: 透過心靈感應來與夥伴交流。如果受到了強烈的衝擊，包裹著身體的液體就會漏出來。

en: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
zh-TW: 操作一種被稱為波導的力量來進行狩獵。這種力量就連巨大的岩石也能擊得粉碎。

en: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.
zh-TW: 能量之源是體內的火焰。如果火焰變小了，牠馬上就會睡著。

en: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.
zh-TW: 會混在海藻屑裡漂浮在大海，並且捕獵來吃海藻的寶可夢，當作大餐飽吃一頓。

en: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
zh-TW: 總是在打瞌睡作夢。剛睡醒的時候會鬧脾氣，所以最好別去招惹牠。

en: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
zh-TW: 在把自己吃土製造出的泥巴塗在腳上之後，無論走在路況多麼差的路上都不會打滑。

en: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.
zh-TW: 在吃掉夢之後會吐出煙霧。吃了快樂的夢時，煙霧是粉紅色的；如果是惡夢，煙霧則是黑灰色的。

en: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
zh-TW: 會吃地面上的積雪。吃得越多，背上的刺就會長得越挺拔。

en: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
zh-TW: 會讓雙手雙腳的爪子帶電，然後將對手撕裂。就算被躲開，也會用飛散的電擊讓對手觸電。

en: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
zh-TW: 會利用從口中發出的超音波探查周圍的狀況。在狹窄的洞窟裡也能靈巧地飛來飛去。

en: It envelops its prey in its veillike arms and draws it down to the deeps, five miles below the ocean's surface.
zh-TW: 會用薄紗般的手腳纏住獵物，將對手拖進８０００公尺深的海中。

en: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
zh-TW: 在不斷的鬥爭中得到了進化。牠交叉著雙臂發出的怒吼能讓一切對手都為之膽怯。

en: It expels both sweat and tears from its eyes. The sweat is a little salty, while the tears have a slight bitterness.
zh-TW: 會從眼睛裡排出汗水和淚水。牠的汗水有一點點鹹，淚水則略微帶著一些苦味。

en: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
zh-TW: 會用蘋果皮的翅膀飛翔，並吐出強酸性的唾液。能變成蘋果的形狀。

en: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.
zh-TW: 用臀部讓水泡膨脹，並包裹住自己的頭部。會和同類比拼水泡的大小。

en: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.
zh-TW: 個性勤奮，只要看見自己不知道的舞蹈，就會很興奮。會拚命練習直到自己也會跳為止。

en: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.
zh-TW: 揮動燃燒著火焰的尾巴，用鋒利的爪子撕裂對手。性情十分粗暴。

en: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
zh-TW: 擁有火焰也無法融化的冰之軀體。能讓空氣中的水分在一瞬間凍結。

en: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
zh-TW: 性格狡猾且凶猛。會趁著雙親不在時侵入巢穴把蛋盜走。

en: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.
zh-TW: 因為有跟人類及寶可夢分享自己食物的習性，所以一直都在到處尋找食物。

en: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
zh-TW: 有著愛鑽洞的習性。會搶奪其他寶可夢築的巢穴，在裡面睡覺。

en: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
zh-TW: 性情非常凶暴。從嘴裡發出的破壞光線能夠將一切燃燒殆盡。

en: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
zh-TW: 擁有非常高的智商。據說牠能記住從出生到死一輩子發生過的所有事情。

en: It has short legs and can't walk very fast, but its neck and tentacles can extend to over three times their usual length to nab distant prey.
zh-TW: 雖然腳短且走得慢，但脖子和觸手能伸長３倍去捕捉在遠處的獵物。

en: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
zh-TW: 一旦做好了戰鬥的準備，牠鼻頭上和腳底的肉球就會散發出極度的高溫。

en: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
zh-TW: 有著預知未來的能力。在保護訓練家的時候，會發揮出最強的力量。

en: It has the world's largest petals. With every step, the petals shake out heavy clouds of toxic pollen.
zh-TW: 身上那些全世界最大的花瓣會隨著牠的每個步伐搖動，散播大量的毒花粉。

en: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.
zh-TW: 根據星星的動向預知未來。雖然擁有強大的精神力量，但生性並不喜好紛爭。

en: It heals the wounds of people and Pokémon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.
zh-TW: 會四處散佈閃閃發亮的鱗粉，治癒人和寶可夢的傷。是阿羅拉的人們信奉的守護神。

en: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
zh-TW: 能敏銳地感知人和寶可夢的感情。一旦感受到敵意就會躲進暗處。

en: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
zh-TW: 每天不吃下４００公斤的食物絕不會善罷甘休。吃飽了就會開始睡覺。

en: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
zh-TW: 據說如果在滿月的夜晚看見皮皮們聚在一起跳舞，就能得到幸福。

en: It is said that if an Onix lives for over 100 years, its composition changes to become diamond-like.
zh-TW: 據說當大岩蛇活到了１００年以上，身體的成分就會變得如同鑽石一般。

en: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
zh-TW: 力量和速度都不太行。是世界上最弱最可憐的寶可夢。

en: It is waiting for the moment to evolve. At this stage, it can only harden, so it remains motionless to avoid attack.
zh-TW: 正處於等待進化的狀態。除了變硬之外什麼都做不了，只能動也不動以免遭受攻擊。

en: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
zh-TW: 會用腳把樹果從樹木上踢落，用來練習挑球，藉此鍛鍊自己的腳法。

en: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
zh-TW: 對森林的各個角落都瞭若指掌。如果有寶可夢受傷了，就會去尋找藥草為牠們治療。

en: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.
zh-TW: 發射腹部帶電的毛來攻擊。要是被牠的毛刺中，就會全身麻痺三天三夜。

en: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
zh-TW: 會旋轉身體使出踢擊。當牠高速旋轉身體時，會直接鑽進地底下。

en: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.
zh-TW: 會用腳發射水泡，包住獵物讓其溺水，然後花時間慢慢品嚐。

en: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
zh-TW: 住在日照充足的水邊。白天在水草做的床上睡覺，太陽下山後就會出來活動。

en: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
zh-TW: 棲息在森林深處。會用頭上的葉子做成笛子，吹出令人感到不安的音色。

en: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokémon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
zh-TW: 棲息在臭氧層，被更強大的寶可夢當成了食物。在逃跑的過程中落到了地上。

en: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.
zh-TW: 棲息在溫暖的淺灘。遇到敵人時，會從嘴裡吐出內臟來攻擊對方。

en: It lives on snowy mountains. It sinks its legs into the snow to absorb water and keep its own temperature down.
zh-TW: 生活在積雪深厚的山上。會透過把腳踩進積雪中來吸收水分和冷氣。

en: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.
zh-TW: 為了尋求作為能量的光而發狂的牠看起來有些痛苦。似乎是來自於其他世界。

en: It looks strong, and that's exactly what it is. As the weather grows colder, its ice tusks grow longer, thicker, and more impressive.
zh-TW: 牠的力量就如外表那樣強大。天氣越是寒冷，牠的冰牙就會長得越粗、越長、越結實。

en: It loves helping out with construction projects. It loves it so much that if rain causes work to halt, it swings its log around and throws a tantrum.
zh-TW: 喜歡幫忙做建築的工作。因為下雨而停工時，會亂揮木材大鬧一番。

en: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.
zh-TW: 偽裝成燈的樣子藏身在城鎮裡。一旦發現了臨近死期的人，便會悄悄地跟在後面。

en: It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
zh-TW: 會建造絕對無法逃脫的缽狀巢穴，並在巢穴裡等著獵物自己掉進來。

en: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.
zh-TW: 用花粉和花蜜製作團子。依調配的種類和劑量不同，團子的效果也不一樣。

en: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
zh-TW: 透過讓自身的毒素產生化學反應來發電。電力雖然弱，卻能造成麻痺。

en: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.
zh-TW: 會用背上的硬毛摩擦樹木，留下代表自己地盤的標記。性情比伽勒爾的蛇紋熊溫馴。

en: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
zh-TW: 身體是融化成液狀的鋼鐵。能夠將地底的鐵或其他金屬溶解後吸收進體內。

en: It mimics everyone it sees, but it puts extra effort into copying the graceful dance steps of Mr. Rime as practice.
zh-TW: 會模仿一切映入眼簾的事物。一心一意模仿踏冰人偶華麗的舞步，不停地練習。

en: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.
zh-TW: 張大嘴巴移動，連同沙子把對手一整個吞下去。會從鼻孔把沙子噴出來丟掉。

en: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.
zh-TW: 行動迅速，會噴出毒液來戰鬥。敏捷蟲擔綱主角的電影和漫畫擁有極高的人氣。

en: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
zh-TW: 必須靠助跑才能飛起來。助跑的距離大約是４公里，奔跑的速度是時速４０公里。

en: It nimbly dashes about to avoid getting pecked by bird Pokémon that would love to make off with its small, nutrient-rich storage ball.
zh-TW: 牠營養豐富的小球是鳥寶可夢的最愛。為了不被啄到而四處逃跑。

en: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.
zh-TW: 會搭上箭羽朝對手射出。在絕對必須射中的時候，會拉緊頭上的藤蔓來集中精神。

en: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.
zh-TW: 會把孩子放在背上的刺與刺之間來哄牠們。這時候絕對不會釋放毒素。

en: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
zh-TW: 會用堅硬的鳥嘴啄樹木。從牠啄擊的節奏可以大致看出牠當時的心情和身體狀況。

en: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.
zh-TW: 能使出一流的投摔招式。帶子被戰鬥時流下的汗水浸濕，顏色越變越深。

en: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
zh-TW: 能夠迅速活動４隻手臂，從各種角度毫不停歇地使出拳擊或手刀。

en: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.
zh-TW: 透過聲音來探測四周。要是惹牠生氣了，牠會連身體方向也不轉就朝你追來。

en: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
zh-TW: 為了尋找食物，會用鼻子摩擦地面來挖掘。偶爾會挖到溫泉。

en: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
zh-TW: 會為了尋找清水而走動。如果長時間不喝水的話，頭上的葉子就會枯萎。

en: It seeks drifting will-o'-the-wisps and sucks them into its empty body. What happens inside is a mystery.
zh-TW: 尋找遊盪的靈魂，吸入自己空洞的身體裡。沒人知道被吸入後會發生什麼事。

en: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.
zh-TW: 電力增強了牠的腳力。當以最高速度奔跑時，時速可以輕易超過９０公里。

en: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.
zh-TW: 能射出刀刃般鋒利的羽毛進行攻擊。雙腳的力量也很強，腳踢的威力同樣不能小看。

en: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
zh-TW: 會噴出棉花保護身體。有時會被颱風吹到地球的另一邊。

en: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
zh-TW: 絕不放過破壞山野環境的人。會用冰冷的翅膀四處飛翔，製造出暴風雪來懲罰他們。

en: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.
zh-TW: 把喝入的海水從眼睛上方的鼻孔中噴出來吸引他人。每天要吃１噸弱丁魚。

en: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.
zh-TW: 自由自在地指揮孩子們與敵人戰鬥。孩子們會為了蜂女王而拼上性命。

en: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.
zh-TW: 能夠潛入對手的影子，模仿對手的動作和能力。在模仿的過程中會變得比本尊更強。

en: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
zh-TW: 會扭動著身體靠近人，然後突然讓頭爆炸。似乎是究極異獸的一種。

en: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
zh-TW: 不但會溜進民宅偷盜，還會吸收人們悔恨時的負面能量。

en: It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea's edge.
zh-TW: 利用氣流，不拍打翅膀就能飛上天空。會在海邊的岩壁上築巢。

en: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
zh-TW: 會從鼻孔噴射出沙子，趁敵人看不清的時候躲進地底下藏身。

en: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
zh-TW: 會旋轉著自己的尾鰭一口氣突擊。能夠以超過１００節的速度貫穿獵物。

en: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.
zh-TW: 旋轉著閃爍自己的發光體。透過改變閃爍的方式來和其他夥伴交流。

en: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
zh-TW: 會用頭上硬如岩石的角攻擊敵人。趁其不備之時大口咬住對方，一旦咬住便再也不會鬆口。

en: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
zh-TW: 從出生那刻起就一直在睡覺。當進入深度睡眠的時候，會變得完全靜止不動。

en: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
zh-TW: 會用電流刺激肌肉，因此能迅速行動。電流也能讓肌肉放鬆並快速治癒酸痛。

en: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
zh-TW: 甲殼裡儲存著樹果。為了避免受到襲擊，會一動不動地躲在岩石下面。

en: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
zh-TW: 會將寒氣聚集在鉗子中然後用力痛毆。就算是厚厚的冰壁也能打得粉碎。

en: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
zh-TW: 每根刺裡都儲存著電力。即使是折斷的刺也至少能持續放電３小時。

en: It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
zh-TW: 會在體毛中儲存靜電。在空氣乾燥的季節會從全身散發出火花。

en: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
zh-TW: 體內儲存著數百公升的毒液，是被稱為究極異獸的生物中的一種。

en: It swims energetically through frigid seas. When it gets tired, it freezes the seawater with its breath so it can rest on the ice.
zh-TW: 在冰冷的大海裡精力十足地游泳。感到疲勞的時候會吐出氣息凍結海水，在冰面上休息。

en: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
zh-TW: 透過２片貝殼的不斷開合來向後方游動。游動的速度相當快。

en: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
zh-TW: 能夠讓意識同步，藉此理解對方的心情。在照顧別人時是很方便的能力。

en: It tends to move in a pack. Individuals squash against one another to toughen their spirits.
zh-TW: 和大群夥伴一起行動，透過和夥伴彼此推擠來鍛鍊自己的忍耐力。

en: It unleashes psychic power from the orb on its forehead. When its power is exhausted, the orb grows dull and dark.
zh-TW: 從額頭的珠子放射出精神力量進行戰鬥。當力量用盡時，珠子的顏色也會褪去。

en: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.
zh-TW: 用自己超群的爆發力和銳利的爪子來制服獵物。不擅長在彎曲的道路上奔跑。

en: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.
zh-TW: 會用堅硬的門牙咬碎樹果後吃下。角的尖端會比雄性還要圓一些。

en: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.
zh-TW: 揮舞銳利的刀刃將敵人逼向絕境。會用河灘的石頭來精心保養刀刃。

en: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.
zh-TW: 透過音波來聯繫夥伴。人類和其他寶可夢都聽不見牠發出的警告聲。

en: It uses the different poisons in each hand separately when it attacks. The stronger its aroma, the healthier it is.
zh-TW: 會用右手和左手分別施放２種不同的毒來進行攻擊。香氣越濃越有活力。

en: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
zh-TW: 在古代遺跡被發現。會一邊旋轉一邊移動。晚上睡覺的時候也是單腳站著。

en: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
zh-TW: 來自於２萬年前墜落到地上的隕石之中。似乎與極巨化之謎有所關聯。

en: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.
zh-TW: 為了不弄髒額頭上的金幣，會常常洗臉。和伽勒爾的喵喵關係不好。

en: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
zh-TW: 為了讓別人不要害怕自己，特意穿上了看似皮卡丘的破布，結果卻變得更加令人毛骨悚然。

en: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
zh-TW: 會隨著微風一邊轉圈圈一邊愉快地唱歌。許多人因為喜歡這可愛的模樣而培育牠。

en: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.
zh-TW: 為了勝利不擇手段。會看準敵人疏忽的時機，用前腳上的小爪子解決對方。

en: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.
zh-TW: 頭頂上的珊瑚枝即使折斷了也會再長出來。人們會把漂亮的珊瑚枝當成保佑孕婦的護身符。

en: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
zh-TW: 會用熱情的舞蹈抓住敵人的心，再趁對手失去戒心的空檔用熊熊燃燒的火焰把對方燒成灰。

en: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
zh-TW: 會用滾燙的身體勒緊獵物，等到烤得恰到好處之時，就把牠們大口大口地吃掉。

en: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.
zh-TW: 會用爪子在地底挖掘前進。一些農民因為擔心牠會因此糟蹋蔬菜而討厭牠。

en: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.
zh-TW: 率領著一大群駒刀小兵。為了防止手下們背叛自己，總是睜大著眼睛監視牠們。

en: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
zh-TW: 擅長表演默劇。用手指放出的波動製造牆壁，保護自己免於大多數的攻擊。

en: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.
zh-TW: 神經質且容易發脾氣打架。當體內的腎上腺素增加時，毒素的濃度也會提升。

en: It's not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people's homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.
zh-TW: 還不擅長儲存電力。為了吸食電力，會偷偷潛入民宅尋找插座。

en: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.
zh-TW: 有許多看似自然形成的洞窟其實都是龍頭地鼠一陣亂鑽之後留下來的。

en: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
zh-TW: 每當牠拍動翅膀，羽毛就會閃爍出美麗的赤紅火焰。是傳說的鳥寶可夢之一。

en: It's proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that's perfectly heavenly.
zh-TW: 以自己細緻的體毛為傲。尤其額頭上的捲毛，更是有著彷彿會一摸升天的極致觸感。

en: It's rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet's mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.
zh-TW: 據說牠誕生於地底的地幔中，並且在大約１萬年前出現在地表。

en: It's said that drinking the liquid surrounding Reuniclus grants wisdom. Problem is, the liquid is highly toxic to anything besides Reuniclus itself.
zh-TW: 雖然有人說只要喝掉牠特殊的液體就能得到智慧，但對人造細胞卵以外來說，那其實是劇毒。

en: It's said that somewhere in the world, there's a mineral vein housing a large pack of slumbering Carbink. It's also said that this pack has a queen.
zh-TW: 據說在世界的某處，有個沉睡著許多小碎鑽的礦床，群體的女王也在那裡。

en: It's said that this Pokémon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
zh-TW: 藍色的美麗羽毛據說是由冰構成的。會搖曳著長長的尾巴飛過雪山。

en: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
zh-TW: 擁有熟練的進攻和防守技巧。只要得到聲援就會更有衝勁，但有時會為了出風頭而弄巧成拙。

en: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
zh-TW: 對危險很敏感。只要聽到鋼鎧鴉拍打翅膀的聲音，就會馬上挖洞鑽進地下藏身。

en: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.
zh-TW: 能夠自由伸縮身上的８０根觸手。會像撒網般張開觸手捕捉獵物，並用毒針注入劇毒。

en: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
zh-TW: 幽默的動作使牠獲得了眾人的喜愛。能從腹部的圖案釋放出精神力量。

en: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.
zh-TW: 從鰭變化而來的觸手之中，分別流通著正電以及負電。

en: Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.
zh-TW: 身體總是滑溜溜的。雖然游泳時頭總會撞到河底，但牠自己毫不在意。

en: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
zh-TW: 身體被甜甜的蜜汁包裹，背部的皮尤其甘甜，過去曾經是小孩的零食。

en: Its body is solid muscle. When swimming through cold seas, Poliwrath uses its impressive arms to smash through drift ice and plow forward.
zh-TW: 全身都是肌肉。即使是在寒冷的大海也能用結實的手臂擊碎浮冰，奮勇前進。

en: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
zh-TW: 潔癖使得牠連一絲灰塵都無法容忍，會把自己身上滲出的油塗在巢上保持清潔。

en: Its body's cellular structure is similar to the molecular composition of water. It can melt invisibly in water.
zh-TW: 身體細胞的結構與水分子相似。牠能和水融為一體，讓別人無法看見牠。

en: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.
zh-TW: 絲綿般的翅膀會鎖住空氣，呈現蓬蓬鬆鬆的觸感。牠總是會細心地打理翅膀。

en: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
zh-TW: 一直聽牠的叫聲會讓人頭痛不止。會以肉眼無法看清的速度移動。

en: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.
zh-TW: 會優雅地搖擺背鰭、胸鰭和尾鰭，所以被稱為水中的舞者。

en: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
zh-TW: 擁有優雅高貴的身姿。與野蠻的喵頭目個性不合，互相看不起對方。

en: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
zh-TW: 雙眼有著特殊的構造，只要有些微的光線，即使在黑暗中也能看得像白天一樣清楚。

en: Its fangs are highly venomous. If this Pokémon finds prey it thinks it can eat, it leaps for them without any thought of how things might turn out.
zh-TW: 牙齒有劇毒。一旦發現了看似能吃下肚的獵物，就會不加思索地撲上去。

en: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
zh-TW: 喜歡不衛生的地方。如果不及時清理家裡的垃圾，破破袋就會過來居住。

en: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.
zh-TW: 能以小小的腳靈巧地步行。會無聲無息地靠近沉睡中的獵物，用獠牙咬住對方並且吸食血液。

en: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.
zh-TW: 用孢子閃爍著的光吸引獵物，讓對方睡著。會從指尖吸收精氣。

en: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
zh-TW: 有著不會疲勞的強韌肉體。會去幫助人類完成例如搬運沉重行李之類的工作。

en: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
zh-TW: 毛髮能發揮肌肉纖維般的作用。伸展開來時會像觸手那樣把對手纏繞起來。

en: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
zh-TW: 堅硬的鉗子攻守皆宜。好勝蟹與好勝蟹之間的戰鬥就像是拳擊賽一樣。

en: Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.
zh-TW: 因為無比巨大而受歡迎。觀看吼鯨王的生態在各地都是非常受歡迎的遊覽項目。

en: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
zh-TW: 雖然堅硬的鉗子有著１萬馬力的力量，但尺寸太大讓牠行動遲緩。

en: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
zh-TW: 長得長長的角是為了向異性求愛而存在的。牠從不會把角當作武器。

en: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can't breathe unless it's underwater.
zh-TW: 雖然能用自豪的腳力以６０公里的時速奔跑，但是只能在水中呼吸。

en: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.
zh-TW: 強顎雞母蟲大大的顎部擁有能夠折斷粗壯樹枝的威力。連天敵稚山雀都會因此逃跑。

en: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
zh-TW: 能從指尖射出速度高達３馬赫的水槍。牠的瞬膜能幫助牠看穿敵人的弱點，準確地擊中要害。

en: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
zh-TW: 雌蕊會散發一種極其強烈的惡臭，能讓２公里外的人昏倒。

en: Its poison is potent, but it rarely sees use. This Pokémon prefers to use physical force instead, going on rampages with its car-crushing strength.
zh-TW: 雖然擁有劇毒，但只有在極少數的情況下才會使用。會用能敲爛汽車的怪力亂打一通。

en: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
zh-TW: 堅盾劍怪曾經用強大的靈力控制人和寶可夢，建立了適合自己生活的國家。

en: Its punches slice the air. They are launched at such high speed, even a slight graze could cause a burn.
zh-TW: 使出的拳擊能劈開空氣。出拳的速度極為迅速，即便只是擦過都會造成灼傷。

en: Its search for food sometimes leads it onto land, where it leaves behind a sticky trail of slime as it passes through.
zh-TW: 為了覓食也會登上陸地。海兔獸經過的地方會留下黏糊糊的黏液。

en: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
zh-TW: 貝殼非常堅硬，連凝固汽油彈都無法破壞。只有攻擊的時候才會張開。

en: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
zh-TW: 身體滑溜溜的很難抓住。某個地區流傳著泥泥鰍是由泥土凝結而成的說法。

en: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
zh-TW: 長長的身體內部幾乎全被胃佔滿。因為食量很大，飼養牠的伙食費相當驚人。

en: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
zh-TW: 據說如果被牠氣體狀的舌頭舔到，身體就會無法停止顫抖，最終將會導致死亡。

en: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
zh-TW: 牠之所以會以獨特的方式盤繞自己的身體，是為了能更有效率地噴射沙囊中的沙子。

en: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.
zh-TW: 用尾巴上的火焰燃燒毒囊裡製造出的體液，生成出毒氣。

en: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
zh-TW: 全身都是肌肉，雖然體型只有小孩那麼大，卻可以扔飛１００個大人。

en: Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
zh-TW: 能用翅膀飛到距離地面１４００公尺的高度。會吐出高溫的火焰。

en: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that's become as hard as metal.
zh-TW: 體毛變成了像金屬一般堅硬的鱗片。透過敲響鱗片來和夥伴溝通。

en: Jewels are buried in the caves these Pokémon nest in, but you'll be torn apart by claws and fangs the moment you enter one of these caves.
zh-TW: 會把寶石埋藏在自己棲息的洞窟裡。但只要入侵牠的洞窟，就會立刻被牠的爪子和牙齒撕碎。

en: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokémon. It won't stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.
zh-TW: 肺活量之大在寶可夢界數一數二。會不停唱搖籃曲直到對方睡著為止。

en: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.
zh-TW: 會附在寶可夢的身上吸收靜電。自身並沒有製造電的能力。

en: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
zh-TW: 嬌小的體型讓牠能敏捷地飛翔。攻其不備的戰法將體型巨大的對手玩弄於股掌之間。

en: Klefki sucks in metal ions with the horn topping its head. It seems this Pokémon loves keys so much that its head needed to look like one, too.
zh-TW: 會用頭的前端吸取金屬離子。據說是因為愛鑰匙成癡，因此擬態成鑰匙的樣子。

en: Larvesta's body is warm all over. It spouts fire from the tips of its horns to intimidate predators and scare prey.
zh-TW: 全身都相當溫暖。會從角的尖端噴出火來威嚇天敵或獵物。

en: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
zh-TW: 每當發現喝剩的紅茶，牠就會把自己的身體倒進去，讓那壺紅茶變成怖思壺。

en: Lickilicky can do just about anything with its tongue, which is as dexterous as the human hand. In contrast, Lickilicky's use of its fingers is clumsy.
zh-TW: 舌頭靈巧得不輸人類的手，什麼事情都能用它來完成。相對地，手指倒是很笨拙。

en: Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon's strength.
zh-TW: 古時候有位國王將自己的頭盔製作成波士可多拉頭部的樣子，期盼為自己帶來像牠的強大力量。

en: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
zh-TW: 會用火焰解決獵物。但是一不留神就會把獵物燒得太焦，然後才後悔。

en: Mantyke living in Galar seem to be somewhat sluggish. The colder waters of the seas in this region may be the cause.
zh-TW: 也許是因為海水溫度偏低，伽勒爾地區的小球飛魚動作似乎有點遲緩。

en: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
zh-TW: 很多發電廠會用地面屬性的寶可夢當守衛，藉以對抗想伺機偷吃電力的電擊獸。

en: Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.
zh-TW: ２隻金屬怪組合起來的樣子。會發揮堪比超級電腦的智能去打倒敵人。

en: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
zh-TW: 也被稱為是最美的寶可夢。一直以來為無數的藝術家提供了靈感。

en: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.
zh-TW: 由於能生產營養滿分的鮮奶，自古以來支持著人類與寶可夢的生活。

en: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke's latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.
zh-TW: 大舌貝的毒素竄遍了呆呆獸的大腦，奇蹟似地使牠潛藏的智能覺醒了。

en: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
zh-TW: 白天也生活在昏暗的森林裡。會一邊閃爍一邊散播發著光的孢子來讓敵人陷入沉睡。

en: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.
zh-TW: 偏愛長著青苔的洞窟。青苔中所含的酵素能使牠的尖刺成長得又大又結實。

en: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
zh-TW: 泥巴使牠的蹄變得比岩石還要堅硬，只要一擊就能產生足以破壞卡車的威力。

en: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
zh-TW: 絕對不能觸摸牠影子般的身體，否則牠會讓你看到印刻在牠畫中的恐怖記憶。

en: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
zh-TW: 有著頑強生命力的寶可夢。不論河裡的水有多髒都能適應並繁衍後代。

en: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
zh-TW: 經常出現在田地裡的寶可夢。會透過長在身體上的毛來感應周圍發生的事。

en: On nights when the stars shine, this Pokémon's psychic power is at its strongest. It's unknown just what link Gothorita has to the greater universe.
zh-TW: 哥德小童的精神力量似乎會在星光閃耀的夜晚達到最高點。牠與宇宙的關係至今不明。

en: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
zh-TW: 有時也會發出悅耳的叫聲。身上突起物越大的藍蟾蜍越能以更廣的音域來鳴叫。

en: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.
zh-TW: 滿月的夜晚，如果影子自己動起來並露出笑容，那肯定是耿鬼搞的鬼。

en: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
zh-TW: 每年會有一天，牠們會在特定的時間突然出現，聚集在一起排成一個圈。

en: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.
zh-TW: 毒素在稀釋後能製成藥品。牠是製藥公司的吉祥物，廣受眾人的歡迎。

en: Once hot seasons are over, Lopunny's coat will be replaced with fur that holds a lot of insulating air in preparation for colder weather.
zh-TW: 炎熱的季節結束後，就會換上富含空氣的體毛以備寒天來臨。

en: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
zh-TW: 當火焰在體內積蓄時，火伊布的體溫也會隨之上升到最高９００度。

en: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
zh-TW: 生長在身上的藤蔓斷落後會化為土壤的養分，孕育森林裡的各種植物。

en: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.
zh-TW: 某位少年的發明促使人們開始製造各種活用洛托姆的機器。

en: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
zh-TW: 是一種危險的究極異獸。從牠巨大的雙臂中檢測到了強大的能量反應。

en: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
zh-TW: 會用可愛的動作讓對手放下戒心，趁對方靠過來時冷不防用爪子猛抓，然後得意地大笑。

en: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.
zh-TW: 也被稱為「海灘惡夢」。會操控沙子淹沒獵物，然後吸取對方的靈魂。

en: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
zh-TW: ２０幾隻形成團隊來生活。靠著每個成員明確的分工，在嚴苛的大自然中生存下來。

en: People fear it due to a belief that it devours any who try to cut down trees in its forest, but to the Pokémon it shares its woods with, it's kind.
zh-TW: 人們懼怕牠，因為牠據說會吃掉砍倒森林裡樹木的人。但牠對住在森林裡的寶可夢很親切。

en: Perhaps seeking company, it approaches children. However, it often quickly runs away again when the children play too roughly with it.
zh-TW: 也許是因為渴望擁有夥伴，牠會去接近小孩子。但也經常因為被孩子們戲耍而逃跑。

en: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokémon's head results in a liquid that's sometimes used as a bug repellent.
zh-TW: 會出現在乾淨的水邊。用牠頭上的葉子熬出的汁有時會被當作除蟲劑使用。

en: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.
zh-TW: 雖然人們說把銅鏡怪打磨到發光，牠就能映照出真相，但其實牠非常討厭被打磨。

en: Porygon-Z had a program installed to allow it to move between dimensions, but the program also caused instability in Porygon-Z's behavior.
zh-TW: 在追加了能夠自由進出異次元空間的程式後，動作就變得不穩定了。

en: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.
zh-TW: 利用精神力量在空中飛翔，被稱為古代都市的守護神。也有人認為牠是守護神的使者。

en: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.
zh-TW: 會從耳朵內側眼珠花紋的地方釋放出精神力量，但平時會將那種力量隱藏起來。

en: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
zh-TW: 擁有產出鐵的力量，因而受到人們的崇拜。不知為何，在經過3000年的時間後甦醒過來。

en: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokémon being created in the Galar region.
zh-TW: 傳言說有人偷走了機密研究資料，在伽勒爾地區創造出了新的「屬性：空」。

en: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it's swimming.
zh-TW: 體型雖小，但下盤很有力。會撥開沙子，在沙漠中像是游泳般地自在移動。

en: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.
zh-TW: 主要棲息在沙灘上。會操縱把手伸進自己嘴巴裡的對手，藉此讓自己的身體變得更大。

en: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws' toxic spikes.
zh-TW: 用頸部的爪子夾住獵物後，會直接將對方摔到地上，然後用毒刺戳下去。

en: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.
zh-TW: 嘴部雖然細，但吸力卻很強。就算是比嘴還要大的食物，也都能瞬間吸進口裡吃掉。

en: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
zh-TW: 會為了試自己的身手而登上陸地尋找對手。戰鬥結束後就會回到海裡。

en: Seeing through solid objects uses up a lot of Luxray's electricity, so the Pokémon sleeps for long periods of time to store up energy.
zh-TW: 由於透視會消耗極大量的電能，因此牠會花很長的時間睡覺，藉此儲存能量。

en: Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.
zh-TW: 忍耐飢餓，不吃任何食物。據說當牠用盡了儲存的能量後，就會開始進化。

en: Shoots water at prey while in the water. Withdraws into its shell when in danger.
zh-TW: 會從水面噴水來擊落獵物。當遇到危險時，會把手腳縮進甲殼裡保護自己。

en: Since Dedenne can't generate much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.
zh-TW: 由於發電的能力不強，因此會從插座或其他的電氣寶可夢那裡偷電。

en: Skimming the water's surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
zh-TW: 會貼著海面飛行，用大大的鳥嘴連著海水一起把食物撈起來帶走。

en: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
zh-TW: 太陽能量是力量的來源，所以在白天裡很強。旋轉時身體會發光。

en: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.
zh-TW: 被稱為能召喚雨雲的神明。生氣時會用像鐘聲一般令人毛骨悚然的聲音來威嚇對手。

en: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
zh-TW: 據說當牠與威脅到生態系統的對手戰鬥時，會變化成更強大的樣子。

en: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.
zh-TW: 據說牠頭上的天線會接收來自宇宙的電波，讓牠被未知的對象控制。

en: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
zh-TW: 也有人說牠是萬念俱灰的靈魂聚在一起的樣子。會在黑夜裡靜靜地飄盪。

en: Sometimes found drifting above wheat fields, this Pokémon can control the memories of its opponents.
zh-TW: 能控制對方的記憶。經常有人看到牠在麥田的上方徘徊。

en: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don't mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.
zh-TW: 有時會因為無法理解訓練家的指令而目瞪口呆。那可愛的舉止讓牠深受歡迎。

en: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.
zh-TW: 打開究極之洞的後果，是有可能把異世界的能量和生命召喚到這個世界來。

en: Staring at the swirl on its belly causes drowsiness. This trait of Poliwhirl's has been used in place of lullabies to get children to go to sleep.
zh-TW: 一直盯著牠肚子上的漩渦看，就會想睡覺。牠會利用這花紋來代替搖籃曲去哄孩子睡覺。

en: Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.
zh-TW: 會高速旋轉著身體在海裡游泳，並且同時吸食微小的浮游生物。

en: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.
zh-TW: 偶爾會有石子卡在身體的孔洞裡。因為石居蟹會幫忙把石子拿出來，所以會用心地保護牠們。

en: Stoutland is immensely proud of its impressive moustache. It's said that moustache length is what determines social standing among this species.
zh-TW: 以氣派的鬍鬚為傲的寶可夢。據說在夥伴之間的階級地位就取決於鬍鬚的長度。

en: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
zh-TW: 頭腦很差但力氣很大，只要撞擊就能把高樓大廈撞得粉粹。

en: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.
zh-TW: 如風般地奔馳在山野中。形狀如弓的角能夠敏銳感應到自然災害的預兆。

en: Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.
zh-TW: 會用柔軟的身體一彈一跳地四處移動。體溫上升時，身體就會變成深粉紅色。

en: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokémon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.
zh-TW: 主要的獵物是鳥寶可夢。會從羽毛的縫隙裡噴出火花威嚇對手。

en: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
zh-TW: 由於不穩定的基因，蘊含著各式各樣進化可能性的特殊寶可夢。

en: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.
zh-TW: 許多伽勒爾的迷唇姐擁有美麗又纖細的聲音，甚至有一批對牠們著迷的粉絲。

en: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
zh-TW: 據說有些地區的人覺得牠鼻子的形狀很吉利，而把牠當成幸福的象徵來祭拜。

en: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
zh-TW: 靠著每天不斷地練習，用鼻子吹出的氣球會一點一滴地漸漸變大。

en: The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.
zh-TW: 沒有人知道牠為何會滅絕。過去曾棲息在溫暖的海域，是性情凶暴的古代寶可夢。

en: The coldness emanating from Glaceon causes powdery snow to form, making it quite a popular Pokémon at ski resorts.
zh-TW: 冰伊布釋放出的冷氣能製造出粉狀的雪。這使牠受到各個滑雪場的熱烈歡迎。

en: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
zh-TW: 要是被牠的毒刺給刺中，首先會發麻，接著會奇癢無比，讓人恨不得把皮都給抓爛。

en: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.
zh-TW: 頭上燃燒著的燭光讓牠的身體保持微熱。會拉著迷路孩子的手，將他們帶向靈界。

en: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.
zh-TW: 肚子上的體毛保溫性能優秀。在過去，人們會用牠掉落的毛來製作保暖服裝。

en: The horn on a male Nidoran's forehead contains a powerful poison. This is a very cautious Pokémon, always straining its large ears.
zh-TW: 額頭的角有劇毒。警戒心強，隨時都豎著大耳朵戒備著。

en: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.
zh-TW: 歷經無數次艱難的戰鬥後，牠學會了該如何正確地判斷敵人的力量。

en: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
zh-TW: 南瓜的洞裡發出的光會催眠並控制看到牠的人和寶可夢。

en: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.
zh-TW: ３隻一直都在一起，但每一隻對花蜜的喜好卻略有不同。

en: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
zh-TW: 住在海拔超過３０００公尺的山上。偶爾也會來到城鎮，與住在那裡的孩子們一起玩耍。

en: The petals on this Pokémon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
zh-TW: 雙臂上的花瓣既輕薄又鋒利。而且還能夠收集光線來射出光束。

en: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.
zh-TW: 月亮的盈虧似乎會影響牠力量的增減。每到滿月之夜就會變得活躍。

en: The pointed feathers of these Pokémon are sharper than swords. Skarmory and Corviknight fight viciously over territory.
zh-TW: 尖銳的羽毛比劍還要更鋒利。會和鋼鎧鴉為了爭地盤而激烈爭鬥。

en: The poison in its right hand is quick acting. The poison in its left hand is slow acting. Both are life threatening.
zh-TW: 右手的毒是速效的，左手的毒則是慢性的。無論哪邊的毒性都能致命。

en: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
zh-TW: 會用尾部結實的肌肉發電。與下半身相比，上半身真的太小了。

en: The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.
zh-TW: 當牠帶著巨大轟鳴聲邁開腳步，就連大山都會為之崩裂，周遭的地形也會因而改變。

en: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.
zh-TW: 快樂的音樂節奏會讓樂天河童的細胞活性化，使牠發揮出強大的力量。

en: The scent that constantly emits from its fur is so powerful that this Pokémon's companions will eventually lose their sense of smell.
zh-TW: 由於牠會不斷從體毛裡散發出強烈的香氣，導致夥伴訓練家的嗅覺失靈。

en: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
zh-TW: 殼內好像塞滿了許多幸福，據說只要溫柔地對待牠，牠就會把幸運分給對方。

en: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
zh-TW: 只需要一晝夜時間就能跑完１００００公里的身影令許多人為之沉醉。

en: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
zh-TW: ６隻為一體的寶可夢。慣於團隊行動，會一邊變換陣形一邊戰鬥。

en: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
zh-TW: 面部的皮膚無論受到什麼攻擊都不會受傷，但由於呼吸起來不方便而滅絕了。

en: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
zh-TW: 由特殊金屬構成的身體十分輕盈，能夠靈活地活動。不喜歡下雨，所以住在洞窟裡。

en: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.
zh-TW: 古代人的靈魂變成了寶可夢。為了尋找認得自己長相的人而在遺跡裡徘徊。

en: The spores released from this Pokémon's hands are highly poisonous, but when thoroughly dried, the spores can be used as stomach medicine.
zh-TW: 從雙臂噴出的孢子是劇毒，但據說在徹底乾燥之後，可以作為腸胃藥使用。

en: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
zh-TW: 擁有太陽能發電的結構。如果有人打擾牠發電，牠就會因心理壓力而衰弱。

en: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.
zh-TW: 蓬鬆的體毛聞起來就像棉花糖一樣甜甜的。會放出黏答答的絲纏住敵人。

en: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
zh-TW: 被牠當成住處的茶杯是有名的古董餐具。市面上有很多贗品。

en: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.
zh-TW: ３個頭會輪流去咬敵人。在對方倒下之前，絕對不會停止攻擊。

en: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
zh-TW: ２個身體比雙胞胎還要親近。要是換成別的齒輪兒，就沒有辦法好好咬合。

en: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
zh-TW: ２把劍會用令人眼花繚亂的速度不斷交替攻擊和防禦，藉以制服獵物。

en: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.
zh-TW: 透過震動全身的瘤來引發地震般的晃動。與不良蛙是相近的物種。

en: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
zh-TW: 用尾巴來清掃灰塵。雖說能幫忙打掃是件好事，但牠的潔癖也會讓人感到棘手。

en: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
zh-TW: 為了保護自己的身體而胡亂揮舞前腳的樣子雖然可愛，威力卻大到能將大樹折斷。

en: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
zh-TW: 據說焰后蜥之間在爭鬥時，是透過比拼誰帶著更多隻雄性夜盜火蜥來定勝負的。

en: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.
zh-TW: 聽覺靈敏，連１公里以外針落地的聲音都聽得見，因此平時會待在安靜的地方。

en: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.
zh-TW: 牠的觸角是優秀的感覺器官。只要感覺到有敵人就會立刻躲起來，以此存活到了現在。

en: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
zh-TW: ２個頭會爭搶同一個食物。明明沒有去和別人戰鬥，卻總是遍體鱗傷。

en: There are many depictions of Cofagrigus decorating ancient tombs. They're symbols of the wealth that kings of bygone eras had.
zh-TW: 死神棺象徵著國王的財富，因此許多古墓裡都有牠的壁畫。

en: There is a plant seed on its back right from the day this Pokémon is born. The seed slowly grows larger.
zh-TW: 從出生的時候開始背上就有一顆植物種子。這顆種子會漸漸地長大。

en: There's a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.
zh-TW: 伽勒爾地區的童話中有著美麗的仙子伊布擊退了可怕的龍寶可夢的故事。

en: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
zh-TW: 從尾部的孔洞吸入空氣，燃起火焰。如果孔洞被堵住了，身體就會不舒服。

en: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.
zh-TW: 雖然有人認為牠體內有著生成能量的永動機，但至今仍未得到證實。

en: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.
zh-TW: 雖然擁有可以彈飛職業摔角選手的精神力量，卻因無法好好控制而感到煩惱。

en: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
zh-TW: 三胞胎的地鼠，擁有能夠挖掘到地下１００公里深的潛力。沒人知道牠在地下的部分究竟長成什麼樣子。

en: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.
zh-TW: 不會出現在發生爭端和紛亂的地方。近來幾乎見不到牠的身影。

en: These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.
zh-TW: 會製作填滿空氣的泡泡。當露力麗到河裡玩耍的時候，牠就會用泡泡把露力麗包起來。

en: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.
zh-TW: 非得湊齊６隻才會有安全感。那怕只是少了１隻，都會立刻變得很膽小，隨時想要逃跑。

en: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.
zh-TW: 會以角來判斷彼此的地位。凱羅斯的角越是粗壯氣派，就越能得到異性的愛戴。

en: These Pokémon live in herds of about 20 individuals. Bouffalant that betray the herd will lose the hair on their heads for some reason.
zh-TW: 會組成約２０隻的群體一起生活。不知為何，背叛了群體的爆炸頭水牛頭上的毛會脫落。

en: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
zh-TW: 群居的寶可夢。鼻子的握力十分強勁，甚至能把大石頭弄得粉碎。

en: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.
zh-TW: 把撿來的骨頭裝飾在身上。在骨頭形狀這方面似乎也是有流行趨勢的。

en: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.
zh-TW: 成群結隊襲擊獵物。透過團隊合作，連象牙豬那樣強大的對手也能輕鬆解決。

en: They play with each other by knocking their large tusks together. Their tusks break sometimes, but they grow back so quickly that it isn't a concern.
zh-TW: 會和夥伴們一起互撞牙齒來玩。折斷的牙齒會馬上長出來，所以絲毫都不會在意。

en: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
zh-TW: 據說有小仙奶現身的蛋糕店保證能生意興隆。

en: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
zh-TW: 人們相信牠之所以幾乎不動也不叫地靜靜待著，是因為牠正注視著過去和未來。

en: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
zh-TW: 據說牠會為了將幸福帶給心地善良的人而現身。

en: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.
zh-TW: 會與夥伴互相敲擊鳥嘴來進行溝通，透過敲擊的強度和次數來傳達彼此的心情。

en: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
zh-TW: 會在水中跳舞似地游動來製造漩渦。玩耍時會和夥伴比賽誰做出的漩渦比較大。

en: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
zh-TW: 用植物的莖來戰鬥。莖的揮舞方式存在著好幾種不同的流派。

en: This Pokémon absolutely loves sweet berries. Sometimes it stuffs its cheeks full of so much food that it can't fly properly.
zh-TW: 最喜歡甜甜的樹果。有時會因為在頰囊裡儲存了太多食物，結果讓自己無法好好飛行。

en: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
zh-TW: 任由燃燒的鬃毛隨風飄揚，以每小時２４０公里的速度在大草原上自在奔馳。

en: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.
zh-TW: 不只會大吼，還會從身上的洞發出各種音色與夥伴們彼此溝通。

en: This Pokémon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.
zh-TW: 是時刻為夥伴著想的寶可夢。為了保護棲息地和族群的安全，會讓敵人看到恐怖的幻影。

en: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
zh-TW: 吃掉的垃圾會在體內轉化為毒素。毒素的成分會隨著吃掉的垃圾而不同。

en: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
zh-TW: 發出強光讓獵物暫時失明。趁獵物露出破綻時，用電擊招呼對手。

en: This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.
zh-TW: 能將力量集中在尾巴的珠子，藉此操縱天氣。全身散發著氣場的樣子非常神秘。

en: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
zh-TW: 能利用肌肉的伸縮來產生電流。當牠全身都在抖動時，就代表牠正在激烈地發電。

en: This Pokémon has a habit of spinning round things on its nose, whether those things are Poké Balls or Spheal.
zh-TW: 牠只要看見了圓形的東西，不論那是海豹球或是精靈球，都會把它頂在鼻子上轉轉看。

en: This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it's provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.
zh-TW: 性情溫柔，但一旦被激怒，就會用尖銳的叫聲威嚇對方，並且毫不留情地施加攻擊。

en: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.
zh-TW: 住在古老的洋樓裡。詭異地搖晃手臂上的火焰，以此來催眠對手。
