en: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.
zh-TW: 因為總是位於自己引發的沙暴中心，所以是極少現身於人前的寶可夢。

en: This Pokémon inhabited ancient seas. Although it can only crawl, it still comes up onto land in search of prey.
zh-TW: 曾經棲息在古代的海洋裡。雖然只能爬行，但是為了尋找獵物也會到陸地上來。

en: This Pokémon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
zh-TW: 會將脖子上的岩石射向地面來威嚇對手，趁對手畏縮的時候發起襲擊。

en: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.
zh-TW: 一度滅絕的古代寶可夢。會使用１０隻腳划水，在水中一漂一浮地游動。

en: This Pokémon is courageous but also cautious. It uses the soft fur covering its face to collect information about its surroundings.
zh-TW: 個性勇敢且慎重。會用覆蓋著臉部的軟毛獲取周遭的資訊。

en: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.
zh-TW: 寶石的眼睛發出詭異光芒時，就會攝取人的魂魄。是令人恐懼的寶可夢。

en: This Pokémon is from about 100,000,000 years ago. It has the presence of a king, vicious but magnificent.
zh-TW: 大約１億年前的寶可夢。雖然凶暴，但威風堂堂，有王者的風範。

en: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to temperature changes. When its bud starts to open, that means spring is right around the corner.
zh-TW: 對氣溫的變化很敏感。當牠開始打開花苞，便是冬去春來之時。

en: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.
zh-TW: 又被稱為沙之惡霸。就連厚厚的鐵板也能被牠用強力的下顎輕鬆咬爛。

en: This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.
zh-TW: 人們稱牠為大海的化身。有許多船會在船頭設置快龍的雕像。

en: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.
zh-TW: 絕大部分都是由水組成的身體在海中會與海水同化，令其他生物很難看見牠。

en: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.
zh-TW: 由３隻小磁怪連結而成。會發射出強烈的電波來觀測周圍的狀況。

en: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
zh-TW: 無論何時都用冰塊冰鎮著自己怕熱的臉。會把頭頂上的毛垂到海裡釣食物吃。

en: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
zh-TW: 曾經生活在古代的海邊，能用身體的冰來保存食物，但由於動作太遲緩而滅絕了。

en: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.
zh-TW: 生活在水流平穩的河川裡。會用長長的手腳划水，展現自己優雅的泳姿。

en: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.
zh-TW: 棲息在火山的周圍。在一天結束時，會泡進熔岩中讓身體舒緩疲勞。

en: This Pokémon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
zh-TW: 克服了傷痛後進化得更強更壯。會把骨頭當作武器，勇敢地與敵人交鋒。

en: This Pokémon puffs poisonous spores at its foes. If the spores aren't washed off quickly, they'll grow into mushrooms wherever they land.
zh-TW: 會噴出帶有毒性的孢子。如果不盡快洗掉的話，就會從那裡長出蘑菇來喔。

en: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
zh-TW: 頸部可以伸縮。能從遠處迅速伸長頸部，用銳利的牙齒解決對手。

en: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.
zh-TW: 用尖刺刺裂岩壁之後，牠會用觸手的尖端接觸裂縫吸收營養。

en: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
zh-TW: 以石像般的姿態陷入長久沉眠的寶可夢。幾乎就要被人們所遺忘。

en: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.
zh-TW: 從未來穿越時光而來。能夠治癒傷痛，也會把自己的力量分給草木。

en: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.
zh-TW: 會一邊睡覺一邊操控超能力。夢的內容會影響牠使用的能力。

en: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
zh-TW: 用黏土製成的寶可夢。即使現在也一直遵循著數千年前主人的命令。

en: This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn't changed in 100,000,000 years, so it's called a living fossil.
zh-TW: 在深海調查中被發現的寶可夢。樣子在１億年之間都沒有變化，被人們稱為活化石。

en: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Lileep once lived in warm seas that existed approximately 100,000,000 years ago.
zh-TW: 從化石復原而來的寶可夢。曾經棲息在大約１億年前的溫暖大海裡。

en: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.
zh-TW: 從化石成功復原的寶可夢。正如研究所指出的，雖然牠不會飛，但卻擅於跳躍。

en: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. In the past, it lived with others of its kind in cold lands where there were fewer predators.
zh-TW: 從化石復原成功的寶可夢。曾經群居在天敵不多的寒冷地區。

en: This Pokémon's body is covered in blubber and impressively round. It's faster for Spheal to roll around than walk.
zh-TW: 身體被厚厚的脂肪包裹著，圓得令人讚嘆。用翻滾的方式移動反而比走路還要快。

en: This Pokémon's habitat shapes its physique. According to some theories, life in warm ocean waters causes this variation to develop.
zh-TW: 樣子會因環境不同而改變。也有人說牠到了溫暖的海裡就會變成這個樣子。

en: This Pokémon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
zh-TW: 體內的火焰燃得越旺，力量就越大。火焰的溫度有時甚至能超過１４００度。

en: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.
zh-TW: 念力的威力大得驚人。會把精神力量儲存在額頭的星星裡，以備進化所需。

en: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
zh-TW: 在異世界是人們十分熟悉的究極異獸，有時甚至會被選為踏上旅程時的夥伴。

en: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
zh-TW: 從這種究極異獸像紙一樣薄的身體上，可以感受到如同研磨過的刀刃般的鋒利度。

en: This amazing Pokémon has an awesome sense of balance. It can kick in succession from any position.
zh-TW: 擁有卓越的平衡感。無論處於什麼姿勢都可以連續施展踢擊的厲害角色。

en: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.
zh-TW: 因為想要得到零食而幫助人類工作的貪吃鬼。總是帶著電火花跑來跑去。

en: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
zh-TW: 棲息在濃霧的深處，受到了人們的敬畏。能夠操縱水，是波尼的守護神。

en: This highly territorial Pokémon prefers dry climates. It won't come out of its boulder on rainy days.
zh-TW: 喜歡乾燥的地方，下雨時不會從岩石裡出來。有著很強的地盤意識。

en: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
zh-TW: 非常貪吃，會把刺梭魚整隻吞進嘴裡。偶爾也會搞錯對象去咬其他的寶可夢。

en: This is a ferocious Pokémon from ancient times. Apparently even modern technology is incapable of producing a perfectly restored specimen.
zh-TW: 古代的凶猛寶可夢。據說即使是當今的科學，也無法將牠完美地復原。

en: This is an ancient Pokémon, revived in modern times. It has a violent disposition, and it'll tear apart anything it gets between its hefty jaws.
zh-TW: 復活的古代寶可夢。性情粗暴又任性。能用大顎咬碎任何東西。

en: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.
zh-TW: 個性自戀又愛美，如果不勤快地為牠打理外表，牠有可能會因此變得不聽話。

en: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
zh-TW: 氣勢洶洶的急性子。會大口喝下混濁的水，吸收其中所含的毒素。

en: This species was once very slow. To protect their eggs from other creatures, these Pokémon became able to flee quickly.
zh-TW: 原本動作遲緩。但為了從盯上蛋的傢伙們手裡保護蛋，逃跑的速度就變快了。

en: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
zh-TW: 和狐大盜爭搶地盤。能夠悄無聲息地從背後偷偷靠近獵物。

en: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
zh-TW: 個頭雖小，個性粗暴。對於漫不經心就靠近自己的對手會奉上華麗的連擊。

en: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
zh-TW: 能透過自己的角去感受附近生物的情感。正面情緒是牠的能量之源。

en: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
zh-TW: 對西獅海壬來說，戰鬥就是表演的舞台，牠會在華麗地唱歌跳舞的同時給予獵物致命一擊。

en: To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.
zh-TW: 為了讓翅膀成長，每天要用消化液溶化並吸食大量的獵物。

en: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
zh-TW: 為了隱藏漆黑的尾巴而悄悄地生活在黑暗之中。不會主動發動攻擊。

en: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.
zh-TW: 被稱為武神的寶可夢。只有在為了保護什麼的時候，才會去使用自己的肘刀。

en: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.
zh-TW: 無法在炎熱的地方生存。會吐出冷氣來降雪，然後窩在積雪裡睡覺。

en: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.
zh-TW: 擁有高度的飛行能力。雌性擅於持久，雄性擅長速度。

en: Upon encountering an opponent, this Pokémon prepares for battle by extending its claws, which can put out 1,000,000 volts of electricity.
zh-TW: 遇見敵人時會從腳伸出有百萬伏特威力的爪子，為對戰做好準備。

en: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.
zh-TW: 會用變成吸盤狀的背鰭吸附在巨翅飛魚身上，吃牠平常吃剩下的東西。

en: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
zh-TW: 金魚王之所以會用角挖穿河底的岩石來築巢，是為了防止產下的卵被水流沖走。

en: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
zh-TW: 透過葉子來洞悉敵人的動向。只要使出一記拳擊就能讓大型砂石車變成廢鐵。

en: Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.
zh-TW: 會以磁力在空中飛行。能在險峻的山岳中高速穿梭，將獵物逼入絕境。

en: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
zh-TW: 會用頭上的辮子攻擊對手，讓對方安靜下來。破壞力強到能一擊ＫＯ職業拳擊手。

en: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
zh-TW: 聰明伶俐但很會記仇。據說如果敢亂抓牠的尾巴，牠就會纏著你作祟１０００年。

en: Vine growth is accelerated for Tangrowth living in warm climates. If the vines grow long, Tangrowth shortens them by tearing parts of them off.
zh-TW: 棲息的地方越溫暖，藤蔓就會長得越快。當藤蔓變得太長時，就會自己扯斷它來調整長度。

en: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.
zh-TW: 據說牠會飛灑火焰鱗粉造成火災，也有說法說牠會去救助受寒冷所苦的生物。

en: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.
zh-TW: 由於很快就會長大，屁股上的骸骨會接著傳給巢裡更小的禿鷹丫頭用。

en: Walrein's tusks keep growing throughout its life. Tusks broken in battle will grow back to their usual impressive size in a year.
zh-TW: 獠牙會一輩子不停地成長。即使在戰鬥中折斷，也只需要１年的時間就又能長得巨大如初。

en: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.
zh-TW: 為了不被小看而一直瞪著對手，然而繃緊的神經一旦稍有放鬆，牠就會在無意中露出笑臉。

en: Weighed down by a large and heavy shell, Omastar couldn't move very fast. Some say it went extinct because it was unable to catch food.
zh-TW: 據說是又大又重的殼導致牠的行動變得遲緩到無法捕捉獵物，因此才會滅絕的。

en: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
zh-TW: 當牠感到幸福的時候，手中產生出的鮮奶油會變得更加香濃甜美。

en: When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron's shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.
zh-TW: 進化時身上的鋼鐵盔甲會脫落。以前的人會把它撿起來用在生活上。

en: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.
zh-TW: 如果認真起來，大齒輪外圈的齒輪會和小齒輪完全接合。此時轉速將會大幅提升。

en: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
zh-TW: 大口吸氣時，肚子裡的火焰就會燃燒得更旺盛，達到攝氏２０００度。

en: When Mienshao comes across a truly challenging opponent, it will lighten itself by biting off the fur on its arms.
zh-TW: 當牠遇上真正的強敵時，會將雙臂的毛咬斷丟棄，讓自己的身體更加輕盈。

en: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
zh-TW: 皮卡丘們把尾巴貼在一起交換電流，其實是在互相打招呼。

en: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokémon is about to charge with astounding speed.
zh-TW: 如果牠開始用尾巴抽打自己的身體，那就危險了。牠會用驚人的速度猛衝過來喔。

en: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.
zh-TW: 一旦叫了起來，就會被自己的聲音嚇到，然後用更大的聲音大吼大叫。叫到累了就會睡著。

en: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.
zh-TW: 一旦被敵人襲擊，便會關上殼蓋保護自己。不過蓋蓋蟲能打得開。

en: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokémon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokémon to gather around it.
zh-TW: 沐浴陽光後就會散發出甘甜迷人的香味，因此蟲寶可夢會被吸引而來。

en: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.
zh-TW: 對手的體型越是巨大，牠就會喝下越多的水使身體膨脹，彷彿馬上就要破裂一般。

en: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.
zh-TW: 會對聲音產生反應而動起來。在能量核心的影響下，牠摸起來暖暖的。

en: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.
zh-TW: 不管遇到什麼都習慣先咬再說。據說如果咬起來味道不錯，牠就會牢牢記住那種氣味。

en: When it finds a stone appealing, it creates a hole inside it and uses it as its home. This Pokémon is the natural enemy of Roggenrola and Rolycoly.
zh-TW: 會在自己喜歡的石頭上開洞當成住所。對石丸子還有小炭仔來說是天敵。

en: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.
zh-TW: 當憤怒達到極限時，就會噴出暴風雪，把敵人和夥伴都凍成冰塊。

en: When the weather gets hot, these Pokémon turn into water vapor. Cryogonal are almost never seen during summer.
zh-TW: 天氣一熱，就會變成水蒸氣。在夏天見到牠的機會少之又少。

en: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.
zh-TW: ３顆頭團結一致發出的精神力量威力強大。天氣變陰時動作就會變得遲緩。

en: When this Pokémon becomes angry, its pores secrete a poisonous sweat, which it sprays at its opponent's eyes.
zh-TW: 發怒的時候會從全身的毛孔裡噴出混合了毒素的汗液，瞄準對手的眼睛發動攻擊。

en: When this Pokémon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
zh-TW: 一旦興奮體溫就會急速上升。赤手去摸牠有時甚至會被灼傷。

en: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.
zh-TW: 健康時鼻涕的黏度會變強。只要遇到自己討厭的對手，就會把鼻涕擦到對方身上。

en: When this Pokémon's tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
zh-TW: 尾巴浸在水裡時會滲出甜味，牠會以此當誘餌來吸引並且釣起寶可夢。

en: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
zh-TW: 受到襲擊時流下的汗水非常甜美可口。那種香氣會吸引更多敵人的注意。

en: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
zh-TW: 為了在地面上行走時不讓皮膚乾燥，會用有毒的黏膜覆蓋身體。

en: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.
zh-TW: 每到滿月時，胖嘟嘟會成群結隊地來到海面上。這麼做是為了等待獵物上門。

en: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.
zh-TW: 在洞窟中，如果抬頭看到牆壁上留著心形的痕跡，就代表滾滾蝙蝠住在那裡。

en: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
zh-TW: 進入戰鬥狀態後，牠會把煤炭山燃燒得通紅，飛撒火花來燒焦四周。

en: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
zh-TW: 性情極具攻擊性。危險的不只是牠燒燙的身體，大大的獠牙也銳利無比。

en: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
zh-TW: 用結實的外殼保護自己。會從顎部的尖端放出電流反擊對手。

en: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
zh-TW: 雖然性情非常粗魯，但也有重視家族、夥伴和地盤的一面。

en: While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.
zh-TW: 雖然有人說這種寶可夢已經滅絕，但牠在一部分地區似乎是相當常見的。

en: While usually kindhearted, it can be terrifying if angered. Tusks that can slice through steel beams are how Haxorus deals with its adversaries.
zh-TW: 性情溫和，但生起氣來非常恐怖。會用自己那引以為傲，可以削鐵如泥的牙齒攻擊敵人。

en: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
zh-TW: 雖然還是孩子，但已擁有美麗的６根尾巴。長大後尾巴會變得更多。

en: Whirlipede protects itself with a sturdy shell and poisonous spikes while it stores up the energy it'll need for evolution.
zh-TW: 用堅硬的殼和有毒的刺保護自己，同時累積進化所需的能量。

en: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
zh-TW: 靠著輕盈的身體和銳利的爪子到處去偷食物和蛋。逐電犬是牠的天敵。

en: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
zh-TW: 會發出沙鈴般的聲音。鳥寶可夢會因那輕快的節奏而受驚飛走。

en: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
zh-TW: 喜歡動歪腦筋，把人們引誘到深夜的森林中。似乎擁有培育農作物的能力。

en: With swift movements, this Pokémon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
zh-TW: 會用敏捷的動作將獵物一步步地逼入絕境。尖牙總是瞄準著對方的要害。

en: With the arrival of a storm at sea, this Pokémon will show itself on the surface. When a Kingdra and a Dragonite meet, a fierce battle ensues.
zh-TW: 暴風雨來襲時會在海面上現身。如果撞見了快龍，就會展開激烈的爭鬥。

en: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
zh-TW: 用背上的長毛來接收閃電和電氣寶可夢釋放的電擊，然後將之儲存在電囊中。

en: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.
zh-TW: 擁有優秀飛行能力和極度聰明頭腦的牠在伽勒爾地區從事飛翔計程車的工作。

en: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
zh-TW: 巨大的顎部能咬碎岩石。為了不讓沙螺蟒把蛋搶走，會和其他同類一起並肩戰鬥。

en: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokémon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
zh-TW: 體內的毒囊中儲存著滿滿的劇毒，毒性強到能讓吼鯨王都痛苦三天三夜。

en: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
zh-TW: 要是沒讓自己在照顧的多龍梅西亞乘在頭上就靜不下心來，甚至會因此試圖把別的寶可夢放到頭上。

en: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
zh-TW: 傳說的鳥寶可夢。據說只要牠磨蹭翅膀，立刻就會有雷電劈下。

en: Zorua is a timid Pokémon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua's ability to take on the forms of other creatures.
zh-TW: 似乎是因為性情膽小，因此學會了幻化成其他模樣的能力。

en: A barrier reflects back to the target moves like Leech Seed and moves that damage status.
zh-TW: 若對手使用寄生種子或其他會讓寶可夢陷入異常狀態的招式時，可將對手的招式反彈回去。

en: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
zh-TW: 連續踢對手３次進行攻擊。每踢中一次，威力就會提高。

en: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.
zh-TW: 連續踢對手３次進行攻擊。每踢中一次，威力就會提高。

en: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 用翅膀刮起狂風，吹向對手進行攻擊。

en: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 向對手用力投擲大大的蛋進行攻擊。

en: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
zh-TW: 讓對手陷入劇毒狀態。中毒傷害會隨著回合的進行而增加。

en: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
zh-TW: 吸取對手的養分進行攻擊。可以回復給予對手傷害的一半ＨＰ。

en: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.
zh-TW: 用整個身體撞向對手進行攻擊。

en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
zh-TW: 手下留情地攻擊對手，一定會讓對手剩下１ＨＰ。

en: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
zh-TW: 將來自對手的物理攻擊傷害加倍後，返還給該對手。

en: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.
zh-TW: 將來自對手的特殊攻擊傷害加倍後，返還給該對手。

en: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.
zh-TW: 在對手身上植入種子，每回合吸取對手少許的ＨＰ，用來回復自己的ＨＰ。

en: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.
zh-TW: 讓處於睡眠狀態的對手作惡夢，每回合減少一部分HP。

en: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.
zh-TW: 唱出舒服美妙的歌聲，讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, Leech Seed, and Spikes.
zh-TW: 利用旋轉來攻擊對手。也可以擺脫綁緊、緊束，以及解除寄生種子和撒菱等招式。

en: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 向對手發射空氣旋渦進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
zh-TW: 攻擊後迅速返回，和後備寶可夢進行替換。

en: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.
zh-TW: 獲得Ｚ力量的謎擬Ｑ將會以全力進行亂揍攻擊。

en: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
zh-TW: 讓對手身上所有的能力變化顛倒過來，變成和原來相反的狀態。

en: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn the user is in battle.
zh-TW: 招式的威力雖高，但只有在出場戰鬥時，立刻使出才能成功。

en: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
zh-TW: 竭盡全力進行攻擊。自己的ＨＰ越少，招式的威力越大。

en: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
zh-TW: 從拳頭吸取對手的力量。可以回復給予對手傷害的一半ＨＰ。

en: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
zh-TW: 聽了歌聲的寶可夢３回合後將陷入瀕死。替換寶可夢後效果就會消失。

en: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
zh-TW: 封鎖對戰場地，下一回合所有的寶可夢都無法逃走。

en: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
zh-TW: 利用快速移動製造出分身擾亂對手，提高自己的閃避率。

en: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.
zh-TW: 阻止對手出招，最近一次使用的招式在４回合內無法使用。

en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
zh-TW: ♂誘惑♀而♀誘惑♂，讓對手著迷。對手將難以使用招式。

en: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.
zh-TW: 如果此回合內對手已受到傷害，招式威力會變成２倍。

en: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.
zh-TW: 將對手強制拉進黑暗的世界，讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.
zh-TW: 讓細胞再生，回復自己最大ＨＰ的一半。

en: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.
zh-TW: 向對手投擲球狀物體進行攻擊。可連續攻擊２～５次。

en: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.
zh-TW: 向對手發射銳利的針進行攻擊。可連續攻擊２～５次。

en: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!
zh-TW: 寶可夢會為了非常開心的你而慶祝。

en: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.
zh-TW: 將對手困在熊熊燃燒的火焰旋渦中，在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

en: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.
zh-TW: 將對手困在熊熊燃燒的火焰中，在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

en: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.
zh-TW: 用灌注了巨大力量的重踢踢飛對手進行攻擊。

en: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.
zh-TW: 跳起後用膝蓋踢擊對手。沒踢中對手時自己會受到傷害。

en: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用鋒利的手刀劈向對手進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
zh-TW: 從張大的口中發射衝擊波攻擊對手。

en: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用爪子或鐮刀等劈開對手進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.
zh-TW: 向對手發射神奇的念力波進行攻擊。每次給予的傷害都不同。

en: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
zh-TW: 向對手猛烈地噴射大量水流進行攻擊。

en: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.
zh-TW: 向對手噴射強烈水流進行攻擊。

en: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user's very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.
zh-TW: 用非常堅固且厚實的貝殼，在４～５回合內夾住對手進行攻擊。

en: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.
zh-TW: 讓對手看奇怪的光線擾亂對手。使對手混亂。

en: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 從兩側夾住對手，給予傷害。

en: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用巨大的鉗子敲打對手進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.
zh-TW: 向對手發射衝擊波進行攻擊。固定給予20的傷害。

en: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.
zh-TW: 用怒濤般的拳頭毆打對手進行攻擊。連續攻擊２～５次。

en: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
zh-TW: 向對手發射七彩光束進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的攻擊。

en: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.
zh-TW: 用角或喙刺向對手進行攻擊。連續攻擊２～５次。

en: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.
zh-TW: 用尖銳的喙或角刺向對手進行攻擊。

en: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.
The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.
zh-TW: 用２隻腳踢飛對手進行攻擊。連續２次給予傷害。

en: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.
zh-TW: 用連環巴掌拍打對手進行攻擊。會連續攻擊２～５次。

en: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
zh-TW: 用帶有強大力量的拳頭攻擊對手。

en: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 用大大伸展開來的美麗翅膀，撞向對手進行攻擊。

en: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 將如同鞭子般彎曲而細長的藤蔓甩向對手進行攻擊。

en: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
zh-TW: 激怒對手。在３回合內讓對手只能使出給予傷害的招式。

en: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
zh-TW: 利用引力將對手甩飛出去。給予對手和自己等級相同的傷害。

en: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
zh-TW: 吸取來自宇宙的神秘力量，提高自己的防禦和特防。

en: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.
zh-TW: 使用後的第１回合吸收能量，並於第２回合大幅提高自己的特攻、特防和速度。

en: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.
zh-TW: 將自己的ＨＰ和對手的ＨＰ相加，然後雙方友好地平分。

en: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 藉由細胞的變化讓身體液化，大幅提高自己的防禦。

en: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.
zh-TW: 我方的寶可夢手牽手。心情會變得非常幸福。

en: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 從口中吐出特別灼熱的火焰進行攻擊。可降低對手的特攻。

en: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.
zh-TW: 將暗藏機關的盒子遞給對手進行攻擊。但也有可能回復對手的ＨＰ。

en: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.
zh-TW: 向對手投擲捲著暴風雪的冰矛進行攻擊。

en: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.
zh-TW: 將葉片打向對手，進行攻擊。

en: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.
zh-TW: 向對手釋出大量的小靈體進行攻擊。

en: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.
zh-TW: 如驚濤駭浪般地甩動大尾巴攻擊對手。

en: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.
zh-TW: 利用震耳欲聾的爆炸聲所產生的破壞力，攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

en: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.
zh-TW: 用身體的堅硬部分攻擊對手。連續２次給予傷害。

en: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.
zh-TW: 放出無數閃耀著青白色光輝的光線攻擊對手。

en: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.
zh-TW: 全力跳舞進行攻擊。此招式的屬性將變得和自己的屬性相同。

en: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.
zh-TW: 噴出煙霧攻擊對手。有時會使對手混亂。

en: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.
zh-TW: 用尖銳的樹枝刺向對手進行攻擊。

en: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.
zh-TW: 用直衝天空般的上勾拳高高地打飛對手進行攻擊。

en: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
zh-TW: 發射如寶石般閃耀的光芒攻擊對手。

en: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can't flee from battle.
zh-TW: 化成波浪從地面進行攻擊。被捲入波浪中的對手將無法從戰鬥中逃走。

en: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
zh-TW: 叮咬對手進行攻擊。可以吃下對手攜帶的樹果，並獲得樹果的效果。

en: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.
zh-TW: 張開雙手進行阻擋，封住對手的退路，讓對手無法逃走。

en: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.
zh-TW: 呼喚手下，治療自己的傷勢。回復自己最大HP的一半。

en: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 呼喚手下，向對手發動攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
zh-TW: 呼喚手下，覆蓋住自己的身體。可提高自己的防禦和特防。

en: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.
zh-TW: 在對手露出空隙時，趁機交換自己和對手的持有物。

en: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the opponent used last.
zh-TW: 改變屬性，讓自己能夠抵抗對手最近一次使出的招式。

en: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
zh-TW: 盤蜷身體集中精神。可提高自己的攻擊、防禦和命中率。

en: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.
zh-TW: 蜷縮身體使自己顯得很小，大幅提高自己的閃避率。

en: The user counters the target by mimicking the target's last move.
zh-TW: 模仿對手使用的招式，自己也使用相同招式。

en: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
zh-TW: 撒出羽毛，纏住對手的身體。大幅降低對手的攻擊。

en: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 像鑽頭一樣旋轉身體，猛烈地撞擊對手。容易擊中要害。

en: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.
zh-TW: 創造出非常不可思議的空間。在５回合內，所有寶可夢攜帶的道具都會失去效果。

en: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
zh-TW: 創造出非常不可思議的空間。在５回合內，速度慢的寶可夢可以先行動。

en: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
zh-TW: 放出黑霧，讓場上全體寶可夢的能力變化回到初始狀態。

en: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 將身體蜷縮成圓形，提高自己的防禦。

en: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
zh-TW: 發出強烈的閃光，給予對手傷害。

en: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用左右手刀劈打對手進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
zh-TW: 從空中俯衝向對手進行攻擊。此招式同時具有格鬥屬性和飛行屬性。

en: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
zh-TW: 吸取對手的血液進行攻擊。可以回復給予對手傷害的一半ＨＰ。

en: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.
zh-TW: 吸引對手的注意，將對手的攻擊全部轉移到自己身上。

en: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 吃掉攜帶的樹果，大幅提高自己的防禦。

en: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.
zh-TW: 施加引發睡意的暗示，讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
zh-TW: 用超能力將自己和對手的攻擊和特攻各別相加後，再進行平分。

en: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
zh-TW: 用超能力將自己和對手的特性互相交換。

en: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.
zh-TW: 用超能力將自己和對手的能力變化互相交換。

en: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
zh-TW: 一邊可愛地撒嬌，一邊靠近對手，奪取對手攜帶的道具。

en: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
zh-TW: 即使受到再強烈的攻擊，也一定會剩下１ＨＰ。連續使用時容易失敗。

en: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.
zh-TW: 在２回合內忍受攻擊，然後將受到的傷害加倍返還給對手。

en: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.
zh-TW: 用黏糊糊的細絲一層一層纏住對手，讓對手不能從戰鬥中逃走。

en: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.
zh-TW: 將對手和自己的速度進行互換。

en: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.
zh-TW: 伸長自己的影子，從對手的背後進行攻擊。必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

en: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.
zh-TW: 雖然自己會陷入瀕死，但可以讓接替上場的寶可夢回復到萬全狀態。

en: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 裝哭掉眼淚。讓對手不知所措，大幅降低對手的特防。

en: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
zh-TW: 使出全身力量，猛攻對手。

en: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.
zh-TW: 發射如大炮般的電流進行攻擊。能讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

en: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
zh-TW: 變得淚眼汪汪，令對手喪失鬥志。進而降低對手的攻擊和特攻。

en: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 將皮膚變得堅硬如鐵，大幅提高自己的防禦。

en: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
zh-TW: 舉辦茶會，在場上的寶可夢都會吃掉自己攜帶的樹果。

en: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
zh-TW: 支援對手，讓對手緊接在自己之後行動。

en: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.
zh-TW: 潛入對手的影子，奪取對手的能力提升進行攻擊。

en: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.
zh-TW: 向對手發洩自然之怒。會使對手的ＨＰ減半。

en: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.
zh-TW: 在攻擊的時候手下留情，讓對手的ＨＰ一定會剩下１。

en: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.
zh-TW: 向對手的臉等處投擲泥巴進行攻擊。可降低對手的命中率。

en: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
zh-TW: 向自己施加自我暗示，讓能力變化的狀態變得與對手相同。

en: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.
zh-TW: 將超高溫的蒸汽噴向對手。有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.
zh-TW: 對手使出招式之後，能夠透過指令讓對手再次使出相同招式。

en: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.
zh-TW: 用腹部的花紋使對手心生恐懼，讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

en: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
zh-TW: 激勵自己，提高自己的攻擊和特攻。

en: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.
zh-TW: 高高跳起之後使出飛踢攻擊對手。沒踢中對手時自己會受到傷害。

en: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...
zh-TW: 不攻擊對手，只是蹦蹦跳跳的，什麼事也不會發生……

en: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
zh-TW: 像天使般可愛地親吻對手，進而使對手混亂。

en: The user lands and rests its body. It restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.
zh-TW: 降落到地面，讓身體休息。回復自己最大ＨＰ的一半。

en: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 製造出震耳欲聾的巨大聲波攻擊對手。

en: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.
zh-TW: 打個大哈欠引起睡意。在下一回合讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
zh-TW: 朝著對手打嗝進行攻擊。沒吃下樹果時無法使用。

en: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.
zh-TW: 利用電氣產生的磁力浮在空中。在５回合內可以飄浮。

en: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.
zh-TW: 用超能力使對手浮起來。在３回合內攻擊會變得容易命中對手。

en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
zh-TW: 將神奇的念力波實體化後攻擊對手。給予對手物理傷害。

en: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.
zh-TW: 將現有的ＨＰ減去最大ＨＰ的一半，讓自己的攻擊提高至最大值。

en: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.
zh-TW: 喚醒身體深處沉睡的力量，提高自己的攻擊。

en: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
zh-TW: 模仿對手最近一次使用的招式，若對手沒有成功出招則會失敗。

en: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's natural Ability.
zh-TW: 扮演成對手，讓自己的特性也變得和對手相同。

en: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.
zh-TW: 當對手沒有攜帶道具時，能夠將自己攜帶的道具交給對手。

en: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
zh-TW: 用鳥喙進行攻擊。可以吃下對手攜帶的樹果，並獲得樹果的效果。

en: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.
zh-TW: 搖搖晃晃地跳起舞，讓自己周圍的寶可夢陷入混亂狀態。

en: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.
zh-TW: 舉起小岩石，向對手投擲進行攻擊。

en: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.
zh-TW: 用漆黑深邃的眼神一動也不動地凝視對手，讓對手無法從戰鬥中逃走。

en: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.
zh-TW: 發出悅耳的笛聲，讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
zh-TW: 在和對手嬉鬧的同時進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的攻擊。

en: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
zh-TW: 透過適切的指導，提高我方全體的攻擊和防禦。

en: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.
zh-TW: 向對手施加森林詛咒。中了詛咒的對手會被追加草屬性。

en: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
zh-TW: 屏氣凝神，提高自己的特攻和特防。

en: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.
zh-TW: 消耗一些自己的ＨＰ，提高自己的所有能力。

en: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.
zh-TW: 使用神奇的力量，提高場上全體草屬性寶可夢的防禦。

en: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
zh-TW: 利用神奇的芳香，提高我方寶可夢的特防。

en: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
zh-TW: 將在戰鬥中已消耗完的寶可夢持有物回收後，回復成可以使用的狀態。

en: The user reflects the target's type, making it the same type as the target.
zh-TW: 在自己身上反映出對手的屬性，讓自己也變成相同的屬性。

en: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.
zh-TW: 回復自己最大ＨＰ的一半。在沙暴中回復得更多。

en: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
zh-TW: 回復自己的ＨＰ。回復量會隨著天氣的不同而有所變化。

en: The user restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.
zh-TW: 回復對手最大ＨＰ的一半。在青草場地時，效果會提高。

en: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.
zh-TW: 撒出大量令人想睡的粉末，讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.
zh-TW: 撒出魔法粉末，使對手變為超能力屬性。

en: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.
zh-TW: 大把撒出有催眠效果的孢子，讓對手陷入睡眠狀態。

en: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
zh-TW: 用地震的衝擊，攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

en: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.
zh-TW: 將爪子磨得更加鋒利。可提高自己的攻擊和命中率。

en: The user sharply raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
zh-TW: 透過裝飾，大幅提高對手的攻擊和特攻。

en: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.
zh-TW: 削去身體上多餘的部分。以大幅提高自己的速度，同時體重也會變輕。

en: The user shoots a sinister, bluish-white flame at the target to inflict a burn.
zh-TW: 放出詭異的火焰，讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.
zh-TW: 朝對手灑下大量的水，讓對手變成水屬性。

en: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.
zh-TW: 從雙眼釋放出精神力量進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

en: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.
zh-TW: 將混有毒的絲吐向對手。使其中毒，進而降低對手的速度。

en: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.
zh-TW: 用稜鏡的力量發射強烈光線。下一回合自己將無法動彈。

en: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 從對手背後爬近後進行攻擊。會降低對手的特攻。

en: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.
zh-TW: 從上方砸下外殼堅硬的大種子，攻擊對手。

en: The user slams the target with an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
zh-TW: 將大大的樹木甩向對手進行攻擊。下一回合自己將無法動彈。

en: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.
zh-TW: 用翅膀撞向對手進行攻擊。連續２次給予傷害。

en: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 抓住瞬間的空隙斬切對手。容易擊中要害。

en: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用黑影化成的銳利爪子撕裂對手。容易擊中要害。

en: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.
zh-TW: 迅速撞向對手進行攻擊。必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

en: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.
zh-TW: 用捕獸夾，在４～５回合內夾住對手進行攻擊。

en: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.
zh-TW: 將有毒的針刺進對手進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
zh-TW: 用尖尖的角刺進對手進行攻擊。攻擊必定會命中。

en: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 凝視閃爍的光芒，集中精神，極大幅提高自己的特攻。

en: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 使用全身的力量讓身體硬化，提高自己的防禦。

en: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.
zh-TW: 刮起妖精之風，吹向對手進行攻擊。

en: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.
zh-TW: 猛烈地刮起飛雪般的落花，攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

en: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
zh-TW: 用燃燒的鞭子抽打對手。受到攻擊的對手防禦會降低。

en: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.
zh-TW: 向對手發動強烈的一擊。一定會擊中要害。

en: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.
zh-TW: 用堅硬的骨頭毆打對手進行攻擊。連續攻擊２～５次。

en: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.
zh-TW: 向對手連續揮出如子彈般快速且堅硬的拳頭。必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

en: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
zh-TW: 壓制對手，讓對手在回合的最後才能行動。

en: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
zh-TW: 用強烈的酸性氣體包圍周圍所有的寶可夢，並將攜帶的道具融化掉。

en: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.
zh-TW: 揮出強力而沉重的拳頭，給予對手傷害。自己的速度會降低。

en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
zh-TW: 用自己的身體狂舞揮打，給予對手傷害。

en: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 深呼吸後集中精神。讓自己的攻擊變得容易擊中要害。

en: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target's type.
zh-TW: 邀請對手參加萬聖夜。讓對手追加幽靈屬性。

en: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用實體化的精神利刃斬向對手。容易擊中要害。

en: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 將對手連同周圍的空間一起切開，給予對手傷害。容易擊中要害。

en: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 製造堅固的屏障，大幅提高自己的防禦。

en: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.
zh-TW: 搔癢對手的身體，讓對手發笑，降低對手的攻擊和防禦。

en: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
zh-TW: 以肉眼看不清的速度將自己和對手的持有物互相交換。

en: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.
zh-TW: 變身成對手寶可夢的樣子，能夠使用和對手完全相同的招式。

en: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.
zh-TW: 將對手困在電流奔竄的電牢中，在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

en: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.
zh-TW: 將對手困在鋪天蓋地的沙暴中，在４～５回合內進行攻擊。

en: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 放出強力光束後，自己的特攻會大幅降低。

en: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.
zh-TW: 向對手最近一次使用的招式發出怨念，讓該招式減少４ＰＰ。

en: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.
zh-TW: 像錘子般地使用身體向對手發動襲擊，給予傷害。

en: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
zh-TW: 揮動手指刺激自己的大腦，從全部的招式中隨機選出１招使出。

en: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stat.
zh-TW: 可愛地左右搖晃尾巴，誘使對手疏忽大意。可降低對手的防禦。

en: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.
zh-TW: 揮動拳頭，捲起真空波。必定能夠發動先制攻擊。

en: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 縮入殼中保護身體，提高自己的防禦。

en: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.
zh-TW: 向對手發射謎樣的念力波。接收了念力波的對手，特性會變成單純。

en: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.
zh-TW: 可以因應所在的地點如水邊、草叢和洞窟等，改變自己的屬性。

en: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.
zh-TW: 向對手發射憤怒的衝擊波進行攻擊。固定給予40的傷害。

en: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.
zh-TW: 在戰鬥中將其他已學會的招式全部使用過後，才能夠使出的珍藏招式。

en: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.
zh-TW: 提高自己所有的能力，但無法進行替換或逃走。

en: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
zh-TW: 使用招式的２回合後，向對手發送一團念力進行攻擊。

en: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.
zh-TW: 使用歡樂時光後，戰鬥結束時獲得的錢會加倍。

en: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
zh-TW: 用堅硬且華麗的角狠狠地刺進對手進行攻擊。

en: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.
zh-TW: 使用此招式打倒對手時，自己的攻擊會極大幅提高。

en: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
zh-TW: 從自己已學會的招式中隨機選出１個使出。只有在睡眠狀態時可以使用。

en: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.
zh-TW: 用神奇的力量與對手交換場地效果。

en: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a golden gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
zh-TW: 金色的美麗王冠。比銀色王冠更珍貴。有些人收到它會很高興。

en: A beautiful bottle cap that gives off a silver gleam. Some people are happy to receive one.
zh-TW: 銀色的美麗王冠。有些人收到它會很高興。

en: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.
zh-TW: 莓果形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A blue Apricorn. It smells a bit like grass.
zh-TW: 藍色的球果。略有一股青草的香味。

en: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.
zh-TW: 據說在很久以前封印著某隻寶可夢力量的壺。

en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.
zh-TW: 充滿能量的糖果。餵給寶可夢後，能讓１隻寶可夢增加許多經驗值。

en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.
zh-TW: 充滿能量的糖果。餵給寶可夢後，能讓１隻寶可夢增加經驗值。

en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.
zh-TW: 充滿能量的糖果。餵給寶可夢後，能讓１隻寶可夢增加少量經驗值。

en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.
zh-TW: 充滿能量的糖果。餵給寶可夢後，能讓１隻寶可夢增加大量經驗值。

en: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.
zh-TW: 充滿能量的糖果。餵給寶可夢後，能讓１隻寶可夢增加些微經驗值。

en: A capsule that allows a Pokémon with two Abilities to switch between these Abilities when it is used.
zh-TW: 如果用於有著２種特性的寶可夢，就能使其特性變為另外一種的膠囊。

en: A clover-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.
zh-TW: 四葉草形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won't work.
zh-TW: 能隨時連線到寶可夢中心電腦裡的盒子，寄放或領出寶可夢。

en: A fantastic medicine dispensed by the pharmacy in Cianwood City. It fully heals a Pokémon of any ailment.
zh-TW: 在湛藍市的藥店裡得到的，不管什麼寶可夢都能立刻變得精力充沛的高效藥。

en: A flower sometimes bundled in bouquets to convey gratitude on special occasions like birthdays.
zh-TW: 在生日或紀念日等日子裡，為了表達感激之情，有時會將其紮成花束送出。

en: A flower-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.
zh-TW: 花朵形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A fossil from a prehistoric Pokémon that once lived on the land. It looks like the impression from a skin sail.
zh-TW: 很久以前生活在地上的古代寶可夢的化石。好像是頭鰭的一部分。

en: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user's Attack stat.
zh-TW: 激烈地跳起戰舞提升氣勢，大幅提高自己的攻擊。

en: A green Apricorn. It has a mysterious, aromatic scent.
zh-TW: 綠色的球果。有種焦香的香味，非常神奇。

en: A heart-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.
zh-TW: 愛心形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Lunala.
zh-TW: 用來讓需要光的奈克洛茲瑪和露奈雅拉合體的機器。

en: A machine to fuse Necrozma, which needs light, and Solgaleo.
zh-TW: 用來讓需要光的奈克洛茲瑪和索爾迦雷歐合體的機器。

en: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
zh-TW: 讓對手陷入劇毒狀態。中毒傷害會隨著回合的進行而增加。

en: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.
zh-TW: 使用於擁有常見特性的寶可夢，就能把寶可夢的特性改變成稀有特性的膏藥。

en: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's exceptionally sweet.
zh-TW: 能讓特定寶可夢進化的神奇蘋果。非常甜。

en: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It's exceptionally tart.
zh-TW: 能讓特定寶可夢進化的神奇蘋果。非常酸。

en: A pink Apricorn. It has a nice, sweet scent.
zh-TW: 粉紅色的球果。有種甜甜的，好聞的香味。

en: A popular treat in Lumiose City. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
zh-TW: 在密阿雷市很受歡迎的點心。能治癒１隻寶可夢的所有異常狀態。

en: A red Apricorn. It assails your nostrils.
zh-TW: 紅色的球果。有種刺鼻的氣味。

en: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.
zh-TW: 手下留情地攻擊對手，一定會讓對手剩下１ＨＰ。

en: A ribbon-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.
zh-TW: 蝴蝶結形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A sack used to gather and hold volcanic ash.
zh-TW: 用於收集堆積的火山灰的袋子。

en: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用毒刃劈開對手。有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態，也容易擊中要害。

en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places like caves.
zh-TW: 有點與眾不同的球。容易在夜晚或洞窟等陰暗的地方捉到寶可夢。

en: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon while they're asleep.
zh-TW: 有點與眾不同的球。能更容易地捉到睡眠狀態的寶可夢。

en: A special Poké Ball designed to catch Ultra Beasts. It has a low success rate for catching others.
zh-TW: 為捕捉究極異獸而製作的特殊精靈球。很難捕捉究極異獸之外的寶可夢。

en: A splicer that fuses Kyurem and a certain Pokémon. They are said to have been one in the beginning.
zh-TW: 能讓據說原是一體的酋雷姆和某寶可夢合體的一對楔子。

en: A star-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.
zh-TW: 星星形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A strawberry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it will spin around happily.
zh-TW: 草莓形狀的工藝糖果。讓小仙奶攜帶的話，牠會高興得轉圈圈。

en: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
zh-TW: 向對手放出強力電流進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

en: A transparent device overflowing with dubious data.  Its producer is unknown.
zh-TW: 內部儲存了可疑資訊的透明機器。製造者不明。

en: A very tasty tail of something. It can be sold at a high price to shops.
zh-TW: 非常美味的某種尾巴。可以在商店高價出售。

en: A vital item that is needed to keep a stone tower from collapsing. Voices can be heard from it occasionally.
zh-TW: 沒有它，石之塔就會崩塌的重要石頭。有時能從石頭裡聽到聲音。

en: A white Apricorn. It doesn't smell like anything.
zh-TW: 白色的球果。沒有任何氣味。

en: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
zh-TW: 向對手劈下暴雷進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

en: A wondrous orb to be held by either Latios or Latias. It raises the power of Psychic- and Dragon-type moves.
zh-TW: 讓拉帝歐斯或拉帝亞斯攜帶後，超能力和龍屬性的招式威力就會提高的神奇珠子。

en: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.
zh-TW: 利用神奇的屏障，在５回合內減輕來自對手的物理攻擊傷害。

en: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.
zh-TW: 利用神奇的屏障，在５回合內減輕來自對手的特殊攻擊傷害。

en: A yellow Apricorn. It has an invigorating scent.
zh-TW: 黃色的球果。有種清爽的香味。

en: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
zh-TW: 攻擊後迅速返回，和後備寶可夢進行替換。

en: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
zh-TW: 竭盡全力進行攻擊。自己的ＨＰ越少，招式的威力越大。

en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 用於寶可夢的道具。能稍微提高１隻寶可夢的攻擊的基礎點數。

en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 用於寶可夢的道具。能稍微提高１隻寶可夢的防禦的基礎點數。

en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base HP of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 用於寶可夢的道具。能稍微提高１隻寶可夢的HP的基礎點數。

en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Atk stat of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 用於寶可夢的道具。能稍微提高１隻寶可夢的特攻的基礎點數。

en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Sp. Def stat of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 用於寶可夢的道具。能稍微提高１隻寶可夢的特防的基礎點數。

en: An item for use on a Pokémon. It slightly increases the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 用於寶可夢的道具。能稍微提高１隻寶可夢的速度的基礎點數。

en: An item in which Zygarde Cores and Cells are gathered. You can also use it to change Zygarde's forms.
zh-TW: 聚集了寶可夢基格爾德的核心和細胞的道具。可以改變基格爾德的樣子。

en: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Defense stat.
zh-TW: 讓百變怪攜帶後，防禦就會提高的神奇粉末。非常細緻堅硬。

en: An item to be held by Ditto. Extremely fine yet hard, this odd powder boosts the Speed stat.
zh-TW: 讓百變怪攜帶後，速度就會提高的神奇粉末。非常細緻堅硬。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Defense on Electric Terrain. It can only be used once.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在電氣場地上使用，就會提高防禦。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Defense on Grassy Terrain. It can only be used once.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在青草場地上使用，就會提高防禦。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def on Misty Terrain. It can only be used once.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在薄霧場地上使用，就會提高特防。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Def on Psychic Terrain. It can only be used once.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在精神場地上使用，就會提高特防。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts the power of moves, but at the cost of some HP on each hit.
zh-TW: 攜帶後，雖然每次攻擊時ＨＰ會少量減少，但招式的威力會提高。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.
zh-TW: 非常沉重的某種尾巴。攜帶後，行動會比平時更加緩慢。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Lowers Speed when Trick Room takes effect.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，當戲法空間成功時，速度會降低。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Protective moves like Light Screen and Reflect will be effective longer.
zh-TW: 當攜帶它的寶可夢使出光牆或反射壁時，效果會比平時持續得更久。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The comforting chime of this bell calms the holder, making it friendly.
zh-TW: 音色悅耳的鈴鐺。寶可夢攜帶後心情會平靜下來，容易和訓練家變得友好。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder may endure a potential KO attack, leaving it with just 1 HP.
zh-TW: 攜帶後，即便受到可能會導致瀕死的招式，有時也能僅以１ＨＰ撐過去。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder will float in the air until hit. Once hit, this item will burst.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，寶可夢會浮在空中。受到攻擊就會破裂。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Grass-type moves.
zh-TW: 有著神奇香氣的薰香。攜帶後，草屬性的招式威力就會提高。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Psychic-type moves.
zh-TW: 有著神奇香氣的薰香。攜帶後，超能力屬性的招式威力就會提高。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense boosts the power of Rock-type moves.
zh-TW: 有著神奇香氣的薰香。攜帶後，岩石屬性的招式威力就會提高。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This exotic-smelling incense makes the holder bloated and slow moving.
zh-TW: 有著神奇香氣的薰香。攜帶它的寶可夢行動會比平時更加緩慢。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This offensive vest raises Sp. Def but prevents the use of status moves.
zh-TW: 會變得富有攻擊性的背心。雖然攜帶後特防會提高，但會無法使出變化招式。

en: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder's stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.
zh-TW: 當攜帶它的寶可夢能力降低時，將自動和同行寶可夢進行替換。

en: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.
zh-TW: 利用快速移動製造出分身擾亂對手，提高自己的閃避率。

en: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.
zh-TW: 使用後的第１回合潛入水中，並於第２回合浮上來進行攻擊。

en: Enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
zh-TW: 完全防住對手的所有攻擊。連續使用時容易失敗。

en: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will increase the holder's Defense if it's hit with a physical move.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在受到物理招式攻擊時，自己的防禦就會提高。

en: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will increase the holder's Sp. Def if it's hit with a special move.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在受到特殊招式攻擊時，自己的特防就會提高。

en: If held by a Pokémon, this Berry will lessen the damage taken from one supereffective Fairy-type attack.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢攜帶後，在受到效果絕佳的妖精屬性招式攻擊時，能使其威力減弱。

en: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.
zh-TW: ♂誘惑♀而♀誘惑♂，讓對手著迷。對手將難以使用招式。

en: Mahogany Town's famous candy. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
zh-TW: 卡吉鎮特產的饅頭。能治癒１隻寶可夢的所有異常狀態。

en: Pewter City's famous crunchy snack. They can be used to heal all status conditions of a single Pokémon.
zh-TW: 深灰市特產的米果。能治癒１隻寶可夢的所有異常狀態。

en: Shalour City's famous shortbread. It can be used once to heal all the status conditions of a Pokémon.
zh-TW: 娑羅市特產的沙布蕾。能治癒１隻寶可夢的所有異常狀態。

en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.
zh-TW: 很久以前棲息在海裡的古代寶可夢的化石碎片。本來面目至今仍是個謎。

en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once roamed the land. What it looked like is a mystery.
zh-TW: 很久以前棲息在陸地的古代寶可夢的化石碎片。本來面目至今仍是個謎。

en: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once soared through the sky. What it looked like is a mystery.
zh-TW: 很久以前曾翱翔天際的古代寶可夢的化石碎片。本來面目至今仍是個謎。

en: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.
zh-TW: 向對手發射強烈的光線進行攻擊。下一回合自己將無法動彈。

en: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.
zh-TW: 從張大的口中發射衝擊波攻擊對手。

en: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
zh-TW: 用大字形狀的火焰燒盡對手。有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.
zh-TW: 向對手猛烈地噴射大量水流進行攻擊。

en: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
zh-TW: 向對手發射強烈火焰進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
zh-TW: 將堅硬的尾巴甩向對手進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的防禦。

en: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.
zh-TW: 用帶有強大力量的拳頭攻擊對手。

en: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
zh-TW: 以帶有毒性的觸手或手臂刺進對手。有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

en: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.
zh-TW: 向對手發射冰凍光束進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入冰凍狀態。

en: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
zh-TW: 激怒對手。在３回合內讓對手只能使出給予傷害的招式。

en: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
zh-TW: 吸取來自宇宙的神秘力量，提高自己的防禦和特防。

en: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.
zh-TW: 將炎熱的氣息吹向對手進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.
zh-TW: 用身體撞向對手進行攻擊。自己的防禦越高，給予對手的傷害越大。

en: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.
zh-TW: 用強烈的風席捲對手進行攻擊。有時會使對手混亂。

en: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
zh-TW: 使用大浪攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

en: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
zh-TW: 對敵人使用時，用會爆炸的花粉團來攻擊。對我方同伴使用時，則給予有回復效果的花粉團。

en: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 釋放全部能量攻擊對手。使用後因為反作用力，自己的特攻會大幅降低。

en: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
zh-TW: 用連天空也能劈開的空氣之刃進行攻擊。有時會使對手畏縮。

en: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.
zh-TW: 發射如寶石般閃耀的光芒攻擊對手。

en: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
zh-TW: 猛烈地揮下手刀攻擊對手。還可以破壞光牆和反射壁等。

en: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.
zh-TW: 利用精神力量咬住對手進行攻擊。並可破壞光牆和反射壁等。

en: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.
zh-TW: 使用後的第１回合潛入地底，並於第２回合攻擊對手。

en: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.
zh-TW: 在對手露出空隙時，趁機交換自己和對手的持有物。

en: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.
zh-TW: 以驚人的氣勢撲向對手。有時會讓對手畏縮。

en: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.
zh-TW: 使出全身上下所有力量突擊對手。下一回合自己將無法動彈。

en: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.
zh-TW: 要求對手再來一次，讓對手連續３次使出最近一次使用的招式。

en: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 像鑽頭一樣旋轉身體，猛烈地撞擊對手。容易擊中要害。

en: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
zh-TW: 創造出非常不可思議的空間。在５回合內，速度慢的寶可夢可以先行動。

en: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
zh-TW: 在５回合內被神奇的力量守護，不會陷入異常狀態。

en: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.
zh-TW: 消耗一些自己的ＨＰ，製造分身。分身將成為自己的替身。

en: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
zh-TW: 用尖銳的牙齒咬碎對手進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的防禦。

en: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
zh-TW: 用鋒利的貝殼斬切對手進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的防禦。

en: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.
zh-TW: 發出強烈的閃光，給予對手傷害。

en: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.
zh-TW: 吸取對手的血液進行攻擊。可以回復給予對手傷害的一半ＨＰ。

en: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 發射從大自然匯聚而來的生命力量。有時會降低對手的特防。

en: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
zh-TW: 用整個身體壓住對手進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入麻痺狀態。

en: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
zh-TW: 用超能力將自己和對手的特性互相交換。

en: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
zh-TW: 即使受到再強烈的攻擊，也一定會剩下１ＨＰ。連續使用時容易失敗。

en: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.
zh-TW: 使出全身力量，猛攻對手。

en: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
zh-TW: 反守為攻，近身突擊對手。自己的防禦和特防會降低。

en: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.
zh-TW: 使用後的第１回合飛上天空，並於第２回合攻擊對手。

en: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target. This may also make the target flinch.
zh-TW: 將意念的力量集中在前額進行攻擊。有時會讓對手畏縮。

en: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 將身體的光芒聚集在一個點後釋放出去。有時會降低對手的特防。

en: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 利用振動產生出的音波進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的特防。

en: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and heals any status conditions.
zh-TW: 連續睡２回合。回復自己的全部ＨＰ以及治癒所有異常狀態。

en: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 如用劍般操控葉子切斬對手進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.
zh-TW: 將皮膚變得堅硬如鐵，大幅提高自己的防禦。

en: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 提高氣勢，釋放全身所有力量。有時會降低對手的特防。

en: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 投擲一團黑影進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的特防。

en: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.
zh-TW: 激勵自己，提高自己的攻擊和特攻。

en: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.
zh-TW: 有時會讓受到攻擊的對手陷入灼傷狀態。且容易擊中要害。

en: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team's feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.
zh-TW: 將撒菱散布在對手的腳下。讓對手替換出場的寶可夢受到傷害。

en: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
zh-TW: 將來自體內深處的波導之力擊向對手。攻擊必定會命中。

en: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.
zh-TW: 製造出震耳欲聾的巨大聲波攻擊對手。

en: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.
zh-TW: 將神奇的念力波實體化後攻擊對手。給予對手物理傷害。

en: The user nimbly strikes the target. If the user is not holding an item, this attack inflicts massive damage.
zh-TW: 輕巧地攻擊對手。自己沒有攜帶道具時，能給予對手較大的傷害。

en: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
zh-TW: 在和對手嬉鬧的同時進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的攻擊。

en: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
zh-TW: 屏氣凝神，提高自己的特攻和特防。

en: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
zh-TW: 在２～３回合內瘋狂亂打對手進行攻擊。大鬧一番後自己會陷入混亂。

en: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.
zh-TW: 放鬆身體，讓自己變得輕盈以進行高速移動。可大幅提高自己的速度。

en: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.
zh-TW: 從身體散發出充滿惡意的恐怖氣場。有時會使對手畏縮。

en: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.
zh-TW: 用地震的衝擊，攻擊自己周圍所有的寶可夢。

en: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.
zh-TW: 放出詭異的火焰，讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
zh-TW: 向對手噴射滾燙的熱水進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.
zh-TW: 將骯髒的垃圾丟向對手進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

en: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.
zh-TW: 從上方砸下外殼堅硬的大種子，攻擊對手。

en: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
zh-TW: 用水之力量撞向對手進行攻擊。有時會降低對手的防禦。

en: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.
zh-TW: 用如同鋼鐵般堅硬的頭部進行攻擊。有時會讓對手畏縮。

en: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.
zh-TW: 將鐮刀或爪子像剪刀般地交叉，順勢劈開對手。

en: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.
zh-TW: 用尖銳的巨爪撕裂對手進行攻擊。

en: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用黑影化成的銳利爪子撕裂對手。容易擊中要害。

en: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 用尖銳的岩石刺進對手進行攻擊。容易擊中要害。

en: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.
zh-TW: 用尖尖的角刺進對手進行攻擊。攻擊必定會命中。

en: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 動歪腦筋，活化大腦。大幅提高自己的特攻。

en: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
zh-TW: 用３種光線進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入麻痺、灼傷或冰凍的狀態。

en: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.
zh-TW: 降下冰雹，在５回合內場上除了冰屬性以外的寶可夢都會受到傷害。

en: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.
zh-TW: 旋轉雙臂並打向對手。可不顧對手的能力變化給予傷害。

en: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.
zh-TW: 用自己的身體狂舞揮打，給予對手傷害。

en: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
zh-TW: 與後備寶可夢進行替換。替換上場的寶可夢，將承接目前寶可夢的能力變化。

en: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.
zh-TW: 深呼吸後集中精神。讓自己的攻擊變得容易擊中要害。

en: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.
zh-TW: 用神奇的力量瞬間移動，讓自己和同伴的所在位置互換。

en: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.
zh-TW: 將頭腦清空，藉由在一瞬間遺忘某些事大幅提高自己的特防。

en: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.
zh-TW: 將力量集中於體內，增厚肌肉，提高自己的攻擊和防禦。

en: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
zh-TW: 收起翅膀，低空飛行突擊對手。自己也會受到不小的傷害。

en: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
zh-TW: 使用後的第１回合消失到某處，並於第２回合攻擊對手。可不顧對手的守護進行攻擊。

en: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.
zh-TW: 激烈地跳起神秘又強而有力的舞蹈。提高自己的攻擊和速度。

en: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.
zh-TW: 激烈地揮舞藤蔓或觸手向對手進行攻擊。

en: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.
zh-TW: 揮動手指刺激自己的大腦，從全部的招式中隨機選出１招使出。

en: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.
zh-TW: 沒完沒了地向對手大聲咆哮，降低對手的特攻。

en: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
zh-TW: 從身體發出怪異電波影響對手，大幅降低對手的特攻。

en: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
zh-TW: 當自己陷入中毒、麻痺、灼傷等狀態時，向對手使用此招式，威力會變成２倍。

en: This attack move's power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.
zh-TW: 如果受到對手的招式攻擊，給予該對手的傷害就會變成２倍。

en: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only in a hailstorm.
zh-TW: 在５回合內減弱物理和特殊的傷害。在下冰雹時才有效果。

en: Though this feather is beautiful, it's just a regular feather and has no effect on Pokémon.
zh-TW: 僅僅只是漂亮，沒有任何效果，極其普通的羽毛。

en: Throw one into a Pokémon Den to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.
zh-TW: 投進寶可夢的巢穴裡，極巨化寶可夢就會現身。

en: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
zh-TW: 使用招式的２回合後，向對手發送一團念力進行攻擊。

en: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.
zh-TW: 向對手投擲污泥進行攻擊。有時會讓對手陷入中毒狀態。

en: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.
zh-TW: 用堅硬且華麗的角狠狠地刺進對手進行攻擊。

en: When a Pokémon smells this mint, all of its stats will grow at an equal rate.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢聞這種薄荷的氣味，會令攻擊、防禦、速度、特防和特攻均衡地成長。

en: When a Pokémon smells this mint, its Attack will grow more easily, but its Defense will grow more slowly.
zh-TW: 讓寶可夢聞這種薄荷的氣味，會令攻擊變得容易提高，但防禦則難以提高。

en: When used, it activates the Ability of an ally Pokémon.
zh-TW: 使用後，能使我方寶可夢的特性發動。

en: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to drop a held item.
zh-TW: 使用後，我方寶可夢能立刻丟棄攜帶的道具。

en: When used, it causes an ally Pokémon to use its held item.
zh-TW: 使用後，我方寶可夢能立刻使用攜帶的道具。

en: When used, it restores any stat changes of an ally Pokémon.
zh-TW: 使用後，我方寶可夢的能力變化將復原。

en: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.
zh-TW: 從自己已學會的招式中隨機選出１個使出。只有在睡眠狀態時可以使用。

en: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.
zh-TW: 預測我方的攻擊，並閃避其招式。

en: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.
zh-TW: 如果在最後使出招式，招式的威力就會變強。

en: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.
zh-TW: 自己的攻擊雖會變高，但命中率會降低。

en: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a hailstorm.
zh-TW: 天氣為冰雹時，速度會提高。

en: Boosts the Pokémon's evasion in a sandstorm.
zh-TW: 在沙暴中閃避率會提高。

en: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.
zh-TW: 自己和同伴的命中率會提高。

en: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.
zh-TW: 有時會讓接觸到自己的對手陷入灼傷狀態。

en: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.
zh-TW: 有時會讓接觸到自己的對手陷入著迷狀態。

en: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
zh-TW: 有時會讓接觸到自己的對手陷入中毒狀態。
所有天氣的影響都會消失。

en: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.
zh-TW: 一定能從野生寶可夢那裡逃走。

en: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.
zh-TW: 有時能比對手先一步行動。

en: Gives priority to a healing move.
zh-TW: 可以搶先使出回復招式。

en: Gives priority to a status move.
zh-TW: 可以搶先使出變化類招式。

en: Halves the damage from physical moves.
zh-TW: 對手的物理招式造成的傷害會減半。

en: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.
zh-TW: 能力的變化會逆轉，原本提高時會降低，原本降低時會提高。

en: May create another Berry after one is used.
zh-TW: 可多次採收已被使用過的樹果。

en: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.
zh-TW: 受到攻擊時，有時會把對手的招式變為定身法狀態。
龍屬性的招式威力會提高。
電屬性的招式威力會提高。
鋼屬性的招式威力會提高。

en: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.
zh-TW: 會提高我方的特殊招式的威力。

en: Powers up aura and pulse moves.
zh-TW: 波動和波導類招式的威力會提高。

en: Powers up each Pokémon's Dark-type moves.
zh-TW: 全體的惡屬性招式變強。

en: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.
zh-TW: 全體的妖精屬性招式變強。

en: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.
zh-TW: 會讓自己因反作用力而受傷的招式威力會提高。

en: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
zh-TW: 接觸到對手的招式威力會提高。

en: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.
zh-TW: 可讓威力低的招式提高威力來進行攻擊。

en: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.
zh-TW: 即使使出會受反作用力傷害的招式，ＨＰ也不會減少。

en: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.
zh-TW: 可防住對手的球和彈類的招式。

en: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.
zh-TW: 陷入混亂狀態時，閃避率會提高。
可以減少我方受到的傷害。

en: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.
zh-TW: 無論是哪種樹果，吃下去後ＨＰ都會回復。

en: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.
zh-TW: 退回同行隊伍後，ＨＰ會少量回復。

en: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.
zh-TW: 讓樹果成熟，使效果變為２倍。

en: The Pokémon can't use any held items.
The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a hailstorm.
zh-TW: 天氣為冰雹時，會漸漸回復ＨＰ。

en: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.
zh-TW: 天氣為下雨時，會漸漸回復ＨＰ。

en: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.
zh-TW: 使出招式的順序必定會變為最後。

en: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
zh-TW: 不會受到攻擊以外的傷害。
